Heey, just got back from Sierra Sonora – quick job, decent pay. Can't complain, I guess... Now I just have to clean up the grease and salsa verde off the back seat (don't ask). How are you holding up?

Hey, good for you! I'm completely bushed. Helped Judy track down a friend that went missing... she's in rough shape, but Judy's taking good care of her. All I want to do is crawl into bed, but I know I'll just be staring up at the ceiling for hours... Luckily, I have the scene of someone smearing salsa all over your ride to play out in my head, wondering by what miracle they made it out alive...

Doesn't sound too shabby. My day went about as good as it could've – tried closing a chapter of my past with Judy's help. Think I also might've saved someone's life. V vs Night City – 1-0.\nPS You know if you ever open a roadside joint, you'll have to call it "Salsa & Grease", right? ;)
V, that's incredible! You helped someone and they're alive because of you. Looks like Night City has real heroes after all ;)
Judy...? Doesn't ring a bell, don't think you ever mentioned her. Fellow merc? Afterlife drinking buddy? Don't tell me you met her through Rogue, too...
Who is this Judy you speak of? I like the old-timey name.
Judy Alvarez. We met at Lizzie's Bar – club specializing in braindances. She's a tuner there – talented as hell, too. Wasted on cranking up orgasms, if you ask me.

Judy's a close choom of mine – we've been through some shit together... Only a few people I can trust in NC and she's one of them. Quite the character, too. Now that I think of it, you two would hit it off ;)
I'd love to meet her someday. We should go get pierogies together. She likes pierogies... right? Because if she doesn't, I'm afraid you'll have to sever all ties with her. I'm not even joking.
True friends are a hard thing to come by nowadays, especially in NC... I'm glad you have someone you can truly count on.

OK, I can't stop thinking about this, so I'm just going to unload it on you and you can ignore it if you wish. I've had it up to HERE with Saul! Does he TRULY think this family will be better off by selling its soul to a corp? I've never seen someone with their head so far up their ass. Nothing about this is going to end well...

Now don't get mad, BUT maybe dealin with those corpos ain't the worst thing? Gettin along alright with one myself - Takemura, pretty chill and honorable choom. Not all corps are monoliths. Some of their peeps can be decent too.

Preachin to the choir – Arasaka chewed me up and spat me out soon as I stopped being useful... That said, recently met this suit Takemura, worked for Saburo. Pretty decent choom, led by honor, not self interest. Defy expectations sometimes, these corpos...

V, listen to me – working at a megacorp isn't a job like any other, it's an identity. I don't trust them and frankly, anyone who deals with them is asking for trouble. Just be careful, all right? Oh, and thanks, by the way. I stopped thinking about Saul and started thinking about you – much more pleasant ;)

Glad to hear it... :) On the subject of Takemura, I get what you're saying, but I think he really might be cut from a different cloth. I can't really explain it. As for Saul, just follow your instinct. It's what you do best ;)
Anytime ;) I guess you're right about corpos... I have no way of really knowing if Takemura's hiding something or scheming. But you know, with my luck, I'll probably find out soon enough...

Yeah... Worst part is you never know what's riskier – dealing with corps or turning your back on them, especially when you're on your own :/ Look out for yourselves, OK? Probably better to keep a close eye on Saul...

Thanks... Somehow I feel a little better already. It's as if talking to you has somehow unclouded my head. If I know one thing, it's that the Aldecaldos joining up with a corp can only end badly. I feel it in my gut. Hang in there, V ;)
Are you sure you want to disassemble this Iconic item?
Yeah, a real ugly affair, that... Managed to help solve it with a badge from NC. One of the kids was his nephew.
Well, aren't you just full of surprises? I can imagine that must've been quite the ordeal...
Tell me about it. Even now I get sick to my stomach when I think back to it...
Held those boys in stalls like cattle. Glad you didn't see that.

I never told you this... OK, fuck, I've never told this to anyone because I hate remembering it, but... When I was little, my best friend was captured by raffens. It was an accident, and she would have ended up a complete goner if Cassidy hadn't come to the rescue. Some really bad things were about to happen, but Cass pulled out his revolver and the dust settled within seconds. But the kid's uncle... Who is he, anyway?

River Ward. He's a little like Cassidy, I suppose, minus the whole cowboy thing. Self-possessed, unshakable, and a man of principle... Maybe I don't know him all that well, but there's one thing I know for sure – I can come to him with anything and he'd take it seriously.
River Ward? Well, I wouldn't compare him to Cassidy... Let's just say this job didn't get the happy ending we'd hoped for. But the guy's got a level head and a good heart – that I know for sure.
I like him a lot. I feel... I dunno, safe with him.

I don't know any officers, but I haven't exactly heard good things about the police in Night City. Good to know there are exceptions. You always seem to draw the good folks to your side, V. That's a rare thing :)
I can imagine it wasn't easy. Sounds like he risked everything to try and help his family, and that's what counts the most.
I'm keeping my fingers and toes crossed for you two! :))
Hey, did you hear about that psycho who kidnapped kids and kept them somewhere out in the Badlands? Christ, what a sicko. I wouldn't be surprised if he was a Raffen.
I could listen to this on repeat for hours!

I have to tell you something, but if you tell another living soul, I will hunt you down to the ends of the Earth, understood? So, you know that new song from Us Cracks? The one with Kerry Eurodyne? I normally don't listen to that kind of music, but... shit, every time it plays on the radio, I start humming along! You should check it out :)
Well, it's funny you should mention that... the collab between Kerry and Us Cracks was kind of because of me...
Surely, you jest. No, but... seriously?! Come off it, you're not fooling anyone. How would you even know Kerry Eurodyne?!
Well, I do just happen to be one of Night City's finest mercs. Is it really so hard to believe that I'd get gigs from rockerboys? (But for real, I do promise to tell you the whole story one day.)

All thanks to the biochip in my head... I'll have to leave it at that for now, because texting won't do justice to this story's sheer fuckedupness. I'll wait for a better time to lay it all on you over a cold one ;)
I've never met a real rockstar! What's he like? I remember hearing somewhere that he wanted to kill himself? End his career with a bang?

Well, that's not completely untrue... Kerry needed help. And a friend, too. Over the last few years, everything that happened with Johnny and Samurai (it's all on the Net if you want to read about it) really started to get under his skin. He was going through a pretty... violent 3/4-life crisis when I met him. I helped him get through it in one piece. The Us Cracks song is kind of like the icing on this whole cake ;)

For someone who wouldn't be caught dead listening to lazrpop, you sure do know your gossip :P If you ask me, all that talk about Kerry being suicidal and depressed was just typical screamsheet scoptalk. He's a little whacked in the head, sure, but he's fine otherwise. A real nova character, too. The Us Cracks girls were also a treasure to behold – I'm glad they kissed and made up in the end. Believe me – it wasn't easy :D

I hope I'll get a chance to tell you the whole story, unfiltered, but basically... I was part of a crew in Night City. We wanted to make something of ourselves, have everyone at the Afterlife kissing the ground we walked on and not have to worry about next month's rent. This one fixer offered us a heap of eddies to steal the biochip from Arasaka. What could possibly go wrong, we figured...

You already know the rest – the heist went tits up, biochip ended up in my head... Lost my best friend Jackie along with the rest of the crew. Would've met the same fate if the Relic hadn't "resurrected" me. 'Course, nothing's for free. Coming back from the dead came with the ticking time bomb named Johnny Silverhand. That's the universe's sick sense of humor for ya...

Jesus Christ, V... I'm so sorry :( I know this will come as little comfort, but... I get the feeling the V you're talking about no longer exists. The V I know isn't in it for the fame, or money... That's not the V that would sit by the campfire with me and gaze up at the stars. What I'm trying to say is – you've changed, and everything that meant something before means something different now.
I hope you won't see me differently for saying this, but I'm not done showing this city what I'm made of – even if all I can muster up is a big ol' fuck you...
I just want to keep living, Panam, everything else be damned. I don't think that's a lot to ask...

I can't even begin to imagine the hell you've been through... But still, you made it, V. Nobody deserves what you've been left with – least of all you. But you can't give up, all right? You're surrounded by friends. And you'll always have me :)
V... Thanks for telling me all that. For trusting me. I won't tell anyone else – promise. Besides, your story isn't over. Remember that.
Jackie... Who was he? What was he like?

Oh, man... Jackie would've loved you. And vice versa, I think. He was the kind of guy who'd never leave you hanging, never try to rip you off, never let you get hurt... He had this amazing laugh and these god-awful jokes, and he'd often let himself get carried away by some pipe dream... Sometimes it pissed me off, but now I just miss him so goddamn much... Jackie was the best friend I ever had. He was like family to me.

The thing you have to know about Jackie is that Jackie dreamt big, and his dreams infected everyone around him. OK, granted, if a streetpunk gave him one wrong look, they'd get the beatdown of the century, but he also had this strange kind of warmth, an energy that just made him glow. When you were next to him, you felt unstoppable, that everything would work out, because shit was just meant to be... When Jackie was there, I felt indestructible. Can't say I feel the same way now...

Boy, you really know how to put a smile on my face. Scorpion was the same, or more like our friendship was the same. This will sound weird, but he reminded me of water at its stillest. He was inconspicuous, always half-blending into the shadows, but was always right there when you needed him. The world's poorer without him. God, I miss him, too. We're lucky we had people like that in our lives...

No shortage of big dreamers in Night City, is there? I'm guessing more than once you two hatched plans to bring NC to its knees over some cold brews? ;) This just gets me thinking... maybe if I met you earlier, my life would have turned out differently. I tried going up against that city, completely alone, with no one at my side to give a damn about what I wanted or why. Shit, I didn't even know what I wanted... That's why it's good to have people like Jackie around. I'm glad you told me about him :)

I just remembered this one time with Jackie when he swore that if he wanted to, he could become a master sushi chef (because I said using chopsticks was probably his life's greatest achievement). Know what he did? He walked up to this joint in Kabuki and asked for a job – said his futomaki was second to none. They hired him on the spot. Course, three days later they fired him because he kept eating whatever he tried to make. But that's Jackie for ya – one look at him and you knew he was true to his word. You trusted him and gave him a chance :)

Yep... this city and all the shit it throws at us. I'm glad you empathize, but still... I'd rather we didn't have to put up with so much headache and grief. Or maybe that's the only way we can become our real selves... Fuck if I know. Anyway, I'm gonna try being more careful from now on – this city is merciless, takes no prisoners. I don't want anyone else to take a fall because of me...

So, I'm out driving to get some food and guess who I hear on the radio? That's right – Johnny Silverhand! He seems like such a mystery... can you tell me anything about him? What's it really like with him?

In a nutshell? Torture. He's an egocentric, egomaniacal, sarcastic, spiteful, cynical, monumental dickhead. If I forgot something, I'll toss it in later ;) Still, after all the bickering and shit-talking, we still somehow manage to find common ground. Not like we have a choice.

Johnny? He's like that devil that sits on your shoulder, except there's no angel on the other side calling him on his bullshit. OK, jokes aside, the gonk's got his flaws, but his life wasn't all roses and rainbows to begin with. At the end of the day, he can actually be a decent human being when he wants to be...
Could say the same thing about yourself, couldn't you? You have your flaws, life sucker-punched you in the gut, but you're still a decent person, wouldn't you say? ;)

Sure sounds like a handful. But maybe he deserves a chance...? Look, I know I can't talk – after all, I'm not the one with an abusive rockerboy in my head, but I have a feeling that somehow, someday, you and I are going to look back on all this and laugh at the absurdity of it all.
Going back to Johnny... I can tell he's not the kind of guy you can describe in one or two sentences...
I sure as hell hope so. Besides, I'm good at giving people second chances. Something I might've picked up from my adventures with a certain Miss Palmer...
What are you up to? I'm just about to step into the shower, thinking of you... :*
Feelin dirty, huh? Think there's room for two...? Could wash your back, kiss your neck… and I might not stop there... :*
Panaaaam. I can tell you're bored ;)
Bored is the wrong word, more like... restless? I'll remind you that we never really properly finished our ride in the Basilisk...
Mhmmm... I seem to have suddenly gotten the urge to take another spin in the Basilisk. I wonder why...
Haven't seen you around lately. Been traipsing around NC? Just asking, no reason. Not like I miss you or anything... :P
I miss you too :* What's new at the camp?
Hehe, how are things with you?
Well, actually, I wanted to ask your advice on something. I need to talk to Saul about a member of the family. It's a... delicate issue.

There's this Jax fellow (you don't know him) who was leading a scouting mission. He was piloting the drone and was supposed to make sure the area was clear of any Wraiths. Turns out, he completely wrote off a passage out of the basin that a Petrochem convoy had passed through there just the day before, thinking for some reason that the Wraiths wouldn't be lingering there. And well... that's exactly where we got ambushed.

We have footage from the drone. We lost the entire party. Four people, V. Who knows, maybe they could have been saved, but Jax panicked. He tried to cover up the whole mess and by the time we found out what happened it was too late. Now we have to figure out what to do with him...

Look, the gonk obviously fucked up big time, and with four lives weighing on his conscience, he'll probably regret it for the rest of his life. In my book, that's punishment enough. Besides, remember all the shit you pulled behind Saul's back? I wouldn't go too hard on him...

Shit, Panam... I'm sorry to hear that... Normally, I'd tell you to go easy on the guy, but the Aldecaldos have been through too much hardship to let this kind of thing slide. Human error, lapse in judgment, maybe just plain stupidity, who knows... But consequences are in order...
Ehhh, I was afraid you would say that, but you're probably right. This family can only remain together if it not only draws some hard lessons from these kinds of mistakes, but consequences, too...
You're right. I was of the same mind – now I know it's the most sensible approach.
Thanks for talking this over with me.
Every day it's becoming clearer that you're my voice of reason, V. We could use someone like you in the clan – just repeating what everyone else keeps saying ;)
You're really damn important to me, you know that? Just needed to say that :*
Can't wait to see you again ;)
Listen, I can't stop thinking about what we discussed earlier... the chip and, well... how did all that even happen? (No need to answer if you don't want to!)

entries.femaleVariant: "Demiurge" – a fitting name from someone who calls himself "Polyhistor". That said, there's no denying this Mackinaw truly evokes a sense of wrathful divinity. Blessed with gargantuan size and almost apocalyptic power under the hood, its driver will feel like a god of the road. Many would undoubtedly sell their souls to get behind the wheel of this monster truck.

Hello, V. By a stroke of fate, a Quartz Bandit has landed in my lap. The city boy who bought her must have thought he would rule the streets, but his abilities behind the wheel proved just the opposite. He bet her on his first race and ended up walking home by foot. Now she belongs to me. Don't let appearances fool you – some claim there's no faster machine suited to the Badlands... in the right hands, of course. Legend has it that the one and only Billy "Bandit" McCarty worked on this model, with Archer releasing only a handful of units onto the market. I've sent you her coordinates – it would be a shame not to seize this opportunity.

When Archer invited racing legend Billy "Bandit" McCarty to revamp the Quartz, they hoped to improve on the tried and tested formula of their classic sports car. What they got far exceeded even the company engineers' wildest pipe dreams. The Bandit instantly won the hearts of Night City's drag racers, ending Quadra's dominance on the scene virtually overnight. Though not as slick and flashy as the Turbo-R or the Type-66, the Bandit boasts two elements that make it a cult classic: enough horsepower to outrun any other dragster and heaps of soul. When asked what he sees of himself in the model, McCarty supposedly stated that once you take the Bandit's wheel, well – you can't help but commit a traffic violation or three.

One last thing, V. I know how to reward professionalism, loyalty – traits that a certain someone evidently lacked. That reward's called a Quartz Bandit and it now belongs to you. Sending you the coords..

A year has passed since we last heard from Luis Fernando Gonzalo Torres, the bold traveler seeking to unravel the secret of a mysterious syncretic cult. Torres first stumbled upon traces of the sect while in Yugoslavia, where he discovered the remains of a fascinating mural depicting dancers of a forgotten culture. However, the scientific community dismissed his finding as a cheap fake and quickly snuffed out any discussion on the subject. One might wonder: Why so quickly?\nUndeterred, Torres continued in his search, which took him to such far-flung  places as Mongolia, New Zealand, Peru and Madagascar... from which he never returned.  As he slowly pieced together the cult's international puzzle, he saw it all pointed to a powerful ritual based on trancelike dance, puzzling incantations and sacred offerings fed to the flames. From his final notes, we learn he attempted to perform the ceremony. However, his last words give a mysterious warning: "be careful which one you invite to your fire"...
Use at a ripperdoc clinic to increase the stats of a selected implant. Using it again on already improved cyberware allows you to modify the improvement.
Change is the only constant in style. Alter your looks and make them notice you.
Only slightly better than bringing a knife to a gunfight.

Some companies put their mission statement right there in their name. Budget Arms is, obviously, all about value for money, an approach epitomized by the Guillotine. One burst is enough to mow down any non-armored target. Its cheap plastic edging might throw you off, but hey – anyone looking to kill in style wouldn't touch anything "budget" with a stranger's cyberhand anyway.

Some things in Night City come ridiculously cheap – a bottle of booze, human life or the Umbra from Darra Polytechnic. Now, some might claim this India-manufactured Power AR is an unwieldy hunk of low-grade alloy that wouldn't last five minutes in a real Friday night firefight. Those people would be right. However, despite its drawbacks, the Umbra is growing in popularity – you can empty a few clips into a choom, then toss it in the sewer without a second thought.
Fire, kill, toss. Not exactly a keepsake – you'll ditch the Umbra as soon as something better comes along, and not a moment later.

Hey, V. Need a favor, choomba. Wanna hold a clearance sale - no junk, preem merch only. You know me. Problem is, hardly no one else does. Biz is slow - BUT! - that's where you come in. Next time you're around why don't ya stop by, browse around? Won't find better deals anyplace else! And if you could put out a good word to your chooms, I'd really appreciate it...
Hey, V. Got some new contracts lined up for you. Do a good job and your name will pop up on the radar of anyone who's anyone.
When it rains, it pours, huh, V? Glad to hear you're not bumming around. New contracts are available. Sending the info now.
Look at you, V! Definitely turning some heads now. Keep up the pace. Sending new contract info your way.
New contracts, hot and ready! Almost in the major leagues now, V. Feel free to take a day off. You earned it.
Cleared of killing a police officer
A digital short scope handcrafted by one of Night City's countless iron techies.
Precise, discreet and reliable. This holographic handgun scope is nothing short of yet another masterpiece delivered by Arasaka.
Although Kang Tao excels in smart targeting systems, the Jue digital long scope is proof they still value good old-fashioned marksmanship.
A precise, high-quality digital sniper scope by Tsunami. The only thing that could bring you closer to your target is a romantic dinner.

Hey, V! Remember that shooting competition meant to wrangle up some new customers? Yeah, it didn't. Real fuckin shocker, ain't it? Anyway, wanna hold a sale now. (Truth is, aint got much other choice, but that's just between us) I'm strapped for eddies so I'm puttin' up some rare pieces. Cheaper than a Westbrook joytoy. A better bang too. These are invite only but I know you can appreciate a fine piece of iron, so stop by when you can. Won't find better prices in all NC!
Bonus Damage Against Very High-Threat Enemies
Find the club where the fights take place.
Find the ring in the Glen.

Holy fuck, V!!! CITY CENTER IS YOURS. Did so many gigs I threw your way I fuckin ran out! Ain't no doubt in anyone's mind - you're a goddamn legend! Any gonk with their priorities straight better be linin up to buy you booze and blow. Problem is NC's full of shitheads. But at least you got me to show a sign of respect and gratitude. Got just the thing for ya too, baby. You ain't gonna wanna wait to get your hands on this little beauty! It's yours to pick up in your garage whenever, choom! Uncle Dino's got you covered!

This was the last contract you'll see from me, V. Thank you for everything. I'm glad our paths crossed, and I hope they will again someday. I have a parting gift for you - it is already waiting for you in the garage. Take good care of her and think of me when you get behind the wheel. Safe travels, V.

Hey amigo. It's been nice. We nailed some gigs, cracked some jokes, but we don't want things to get stale, ey? Soon as you get too cozy the world blows right by. Got some side shit of my own I wanna focus on. All this bein a fixer, pushin contracts… I'm done with it. Least in a sense. But hey don't cry! Sent you somethin to wipe away those tears. It's waiting for you in your toy stash. See ya round, V!

I don't have any more contracts for you, V. At least for now. Watson is better off thanks to all your work. If I may suggest something – take a break from the city for a while. Burnout can affect even the strongest individuals, so a bit of R&R would do you a world of good. I mean it. There's a little gift waiting for you in your stash to help you on the way. So long, V!

"If thou wouldest get a friend, prove him first and be not hasty to credit him." You were tested many times and did not breach my trust, V. Not only that, but you managed to complete all of my contracts and helped Heywood in the process, which is why Heywood will now help you. There's something I want you to have. It's waiting for you in your stash. Take care, V.

You have learned all of Westbrook's secrets and completed all of my contracts, dear. You've made a name for yourself around here. I'd like to honor you by giving you a special weapon. You will find it in your stash. Good work, V.

Finally. No more calls, no more Watson gigs. That's great. Has anything changed? Not really, if you ask me. Watson's like a feral dog – many have tried to tame and treat it, but all they got is scars and a few bad memories. You went into dark alleys, clashed with some gangoons, got shot at a few times and for what? All you did is diluted the shit that's covering this entire neighborhood. You know that as well as Regina does. Nothing ever changes here. But hey, at least you tried, right? You completed all the assignments – let's celebrate a bit! And Regina won't let you leave empty-handed. Something to remember her by.

The Westbrook gigs are all done and dusted. Wakako said she has something for you – wonder what it is? Another thinly veiled ex-husband threat-story, or something you can actually use? Guess we'll find out soon enough.

Phew. Glad to hear your business in Santo Domingo is finally over. You did what you could – the junkies will keep shooting up, the 6th Street pricks will wave their flags, and all the young punks growing up there will go down one of those two paths. But you've changed the place for the better, if only slightly. Cast a ray of sunlight into a godforsaken cesspit, so to speak. Helping El Capitan was the right call – he gained more control over Santo Domingo, and now he wants to throw in something extra for your efforts digging through all the waste. Guy knows how to reward his flunkies, that's for sure.

So the Saint of Heywood recognized the deeds of his unholy servant? That's lovely. Gotta admit, his sanctimonious attitude in the light of the increasing bodycount was getting on my nerve. The man's the walking definition of hypocrisy. Anyway, that's all over and Padre has a gift for you. Maybe chasing Heywood thugs was actually worth something after all?

Dino may be a poser, but I feel we could still become friends. He's a sex, drugs & rock 'n' roll kinda guy – preem choom material. Anyway, you managed to complete all of his assignments, so he wants to repay you in kind. Bastard's simply impossible to dislike.
Dakota's a good sport. She believes decent work deserves a decent pay, and that is exactly what you will get from her.
+{stat_0}% damage against <Image id="UIIcon.q000_tutorial_icon_boss" align="bottom" width="46" height="57"></> enemies.
V, the name "Ebunike". Remember? Got to the bottom of it.
Little busy with somethin right now
Ha, I remember when Johnny said "call you soon." Only took him 50 years to get back to me.
Hard to tell who's the bigger asshole, him or you.
Good thing I'm used to it. Call me when you're done being busy.
It's about the concert, V. We need to talk.
Don't worry, it's good news. Call me back.
So it's on? Call you soon!
Care to spill a few more detes?
Sure, just give me a call when you have a moment :)
Hey, V. There's this thing I really could use your help with. Heavy stuff. Please come to the Glen in the evening. Sending you the location now.

Hey, it's Rachel from the "Passion" project, remember me? Got a crisis on our hands. Could reeaaally use your help. Stephenson's had a breakdown. Nothing any shrink can do about it. Come here to the studio, says he only wants to talk with you...
Seen the opening numbers? Stephenson's a hit! Great job, really. Cred'll hit your account soon. And should I mention there'll be a bonus? Enjooooy!

You stupid fucking cunt! You happy?! Stephenson doubted! Hesitated! And it's all thanks to you and whatever fucking shit you told him! Whatever, just know you'll pay for this bitch!!! I'll burn you to the fucking ground!!!
entries.maleVariant: You stupid fucking gonk! You happy?! Stephenson doubted! Hesitated! And it's all thanks to you and whatever fucking shit you told him! Whatever, just know you'll pay for this shithead!!! I'll burn you to the fucking ground!!!

entries.femaleVariant: Interested in more work, V? Got a client who needs help getting rid of someone. His name is Bill Jablonsky and he will be waiting for you by a car at the corner of Sixth and Brandon.
Increases Street Cred XP gain by {stat_0}%.
V! I'm doin a little competition at my shootin range. With prizes and everythin! Are you in?
Sorry, Wilson. Shooting for sport isn't my thing.
Well, uh, right now. We'll wait on ya. See ya soon!
Sure, I can respect that, V. But if ya change your mind, come by. We'll be here a while.
heyyyy V! Kirk here. Listen got a gig for ya, quick an easy buck. stop by coyote, tell u all about it. first round on me. Wat say ya?
OK, take your head and bang it against the table. Hard. Maybe that'll help you get rid of all your gonk ideas.
Not battin in the same league Kirk. Don't waste my time again, clear?
Always said you were smart! this time everythings just like its suppose to be. best not stall too long
okok I get it, your sore. But its cool, I don't do grudges. You change your mind, I'll be at the coyote

Hey, V, the NCPD got a call bout a cyberpsycho, actually sent a patrol this time. Been a few hours with no report back. Either those cops got scared and bounced, or… Anyway, check it out for me? Be much appreciated.
Hey, it's Claire, bartender at the Afterlife. Bar's abuzz about you lately, so I thought... Looking for a driver - street races. How's that sound? Meet and talk?
At my garage in Arroyo. I'll give you all the detes. Sometimes I pop out for a minute, so if I'm not there just wait for me... And remember I work nights at the bar ;) Later!
Hm, too bad. If you change your mind, stop by my garage in Arroyo. Sometimes I pop out for a minute, so if I'm not there just wait for me... And remember I work nights at the bar ;) Later!
V, listen. A gunfight broke out in a cafe on the waterfront. See what's goin on over there, k? If it's a cyberpsycho problem, I want that problem to stay alive.

V, got a hot gig. Some soldier just opened fire on pedestrians at the pier. Try and grab him for me, alive. If you can't, well... at least give it a try. Then I'll send the right people for him. Good luck.
V, got a fight at a construction site. Dude responsible is heavily ironed – heard something about lasers. If you manage to get him alive, be a great study candidate. Sending you the detes.
Hey, Maelstrom's got a cyberpsycho problem. As usual, I'm only interested in a problem that's under control, but alive. And be careful. Maelstromers are crazy – psychosis or not.
V, how the hell could you leave Lucy there? You realize Maelstrom's gonna hide her good now, right? I doubt we ever find her now, and there's no one to blame but you. I just don't get it… Talk later.
Hey. Lucy's safe. Preem work. Thanks.
Fuck, V! I mean, wooo... had me on the edge of my fuckin seat! Luckily, it's all over – you handled it like a true profesh. I got the data and you're in the clear. Closin the gig.
Heard whispers Mausser bit the concrete. Nicely done. Gig's sealed – and your boy Dino needs a drink. Later, V.
Preem work, V! Seriously, mad respect. Closin the gig and sendin the eds.

You persuaded Mausser...?! Fuckin hell, if I knew you could wag your tongue like that I coulda made you NC's richest drink-slinger. Wastin your talents on the street instead of behind a bar. But cool, cool – if Mausser's gone, so's the problem. You get your eddies, I close the gig. All good? All good.
Shit, V... Supposed to end Mausser, not just give him a headache. Sorry, no cred for that move.
You're tough as nails, V – a warrior without mercy. Consider the contract fulfilled. Well done.
Well, V, I hadn't expected you to be so... accomodating. Still, let's call the problem put to bed. I'm closing the book on this one.
Nice work on that antenna. The tricky part of having a head is knowing how to use it – but not for you, V. Mosquito's routes are safe and secure again. The contract is closed and closed well.
My, my, you certainly sorted that out cleanly. Why work hard when you can work smart, right? Mosquito's drone routes are safe, you're spry and well-rested, and the contract is closed.
Hahahah! That's what I'm fuckin' talkin' about! Get in, install what you need, get out like it ain't no thing. Gig is closed!
You know, V... half-assing shit is no recipe for success. This radar problem means as much to me as it does to all the Badlands. Next time, I expect to see some legwork put in. Gig closed.
Fantastic job, V. Beautiful, really. My people are already tinkering with the radar. Militech is in for a little surprise. A job well done – your payment is coming in hot.
Y'know, true, I didn't say "Don't make a complete fuckin' mess" – but I didn't think I had to. Larry wants to get back into his biz, not blow it into low Earth orbit. Ah, whatever. Gig closed.

V, I appreciate you handling things as cleanly as you did and exactly as agreed. Bruce was freed and escorted back to Archibald. And the fact that you did it without unnecessary bloodshed isn't lost on me. The payment should be parked in your account by now. Contract closed.
I said no unncessary bloodshed. Did you forget? The job is done and shut, sure. You saved Bruce, but you could have been quieter about it. Until next time.

Thank you for taking care of this, V. Shame Bruce had to get to Archibald on his own, but he got off with a scare. Militech can look for him all they want now. The payment should be parked in your account by now. Contract closed.
I said no unncessary bloodshed. Did you forget? Sure, the job's done, but I seriously question your MO. Next time, stick to the guidelines, hm?

Listen, I know Iris can handle herself, but you leaving her high and dry in the middle of the damn desert just wasn't right. The next time, carry out my instructions to the letter and, well, use your damn head. Gig closed.
V, one of my missing vehicles could be near your current position in the Badlands.
I see you are now in the Glen. Do have a look around the area. I lost contact with a Delamain Network vehicle nearby.
V, a vehicle of mine went dark near your position in Northside Industrial District.
One of my missing vehicles might very well be near where you are now in North Oak.
I understand you are now in Coastview. On high alert, now. I lost contact with a vehicle somewhere in your area.
V, I'm glad things worked out, but next time would you mind ESCORTING THE VIP TO THE CAR? Ugh, contract closed. Be in touch...
What the hell is wrong with you?! You destroyed the car! Fucking up that perfectly just defies belief. I mean, I'm truly at a loss for words...
I'm sending the coordinates of a vehicle that went dark in Rancho Coronado, near where you are now.
Just got word from Tiny M. Thanks for your help – I do like working with pros. Contract closed.
Well, well... these are the results I like to see. Until next time, sister. Gig closed.
entries.maleVariant: Well, well... these are the results I like to see. Until next time, brother. Gig closed.

entries.femaleVariant: It seems you are currently in Wellsprings. I happened to lose contact with one of my vehicles there.
V, Trevor's parents can finally give their boy a proper burial. Thank you, truly. Contract closed.
V, carelessness isn't a trait worth cultivating. Especially not in your line of work. You should have made sure Benedict was safe, not just left him to fend for himself. Anyway, gig closed.
Got word Joanne Koch bit the dust. Preem. Nothin' I love more than workin' with pros. Gig's closed. The eddies are on their way.
Beautiful, V. Red Joe's training starts tomorrow, then it won't be long until you hear his name again. He has potential, that boy. Nice work. Until next time.
I can't say that went exactly how I would've liked, but at least Red Joe has something to train with, and that's what matters. Contract closed.
Thanks, V. Wasn't easy, but you handled it like a pro. Job done, contract closed.
Heard our girl Joanne's already on her way. Oooh, she's in for a warm welcome. Thanks for the help, V. Closin' the gig.
Only thing is, you could have done it quietly. Now half the city's gonna know about this mess. Thought we were on the same page. Whatever. Contract closed.
This sort of gig, no hiccups? Quiet as a roach? Color me impressed. Contract closed, and thanks.
It is not up to you, V, to decide a sinner's fate. We'll have to tell the client that Tucker disappeared. Then we can only hope she never returns to the city. Contract closed.

V, I thought my guidelines were clear. Getting that shard was prio number one! Those people I sent you to? They're pros. Think they're waitin for you to come back? They're gone. You fucked up, V. And it better be the last time. Later.
Great, I knew you'd do me proud. Client's happy – says the Councilor Cole recordings are veeery interesting. Thanks, V. The gig's done.
So, don't want to dirty your hands, trouble your conscience? Understood, V. Tucker Albach will have her Judgement Day yet. I'll see to it. Contract closed.
OK, I'll count the job as done. But technically, just barely, and I ain't happy neither. Callin the client. I'll tell em we got the material on Miss Cole. Gig's shut.
And the spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon and slew thirty men... plus Tucker Albach. Well played, V. Bloody but efficient. Closing the contract.

In trust and secrecy lies our strength. Trust and secrecy. And here you simply show up at Tucker's, then leave? For what? For her to patiently await your return, hm? No. Now Tucker knows she's being hunted. No more secrecy… no more trust. Next time, realize your actions carry consequences.
Preem, V! Exactly the tech I wanted. Thanks, gig closed.
I can truly count on you, V. The guitar is in the right hands – securely now. Closing this contract and transferring your compensation.
There was a problem – you got rid of it. I'm happy, the client's even happier. Good work, V. Gig closed.
One less shithead in this city. Preem. Thanks V, closin' the gig.
Jotaro received. The Mox'll gladly take him off my hands, give him a taste of his own meds. Thanks, gig shut.
Real shame about that cop. I thought you'd handle things... differently. Like, I dunno, using words. Ehh... gig closed.
V of the silver tongue, eh? Glad we got it all worked out. Contract closed.

V, piece of advice – finish what you start. Not only did you not convince Anna to drop the investigation, you might've done the exact opposite. Stubborn as she is, there's no way this ends well. Follow me? I hope so. 'Cause now her life's on your conscience.
I've reestablished the link. A thousand thanks, V. I've transferred a share of your fee to your account.
Jae-Hyun's dead? And here I thought nothing would cheer me up today. Great. Consider the gig closed.
Another asshole shoved in a trunk, where he belongs. Nicely, nicely done. Closing the gig.
Sorry, but I don't get it. You were supposed to plant a bug and instead you blow up the fucking car? Pssh, seriously...
I've made contact with the missing vehicle. I do apologize – particularly impertinent, that one. A share of your fee is being processed.
Control of the vehicle is restored, and I thank you. A share of your fee has been transferred to your account.
Perfect – silent and effective, just like in the movies. Except we don't make that sorta scratch, but you can't have everything, right? Gig closed.
This was supposed to be hush-hush, V. No drawing attention... But all right, the bug's planted – that's the most important thing.
I'm grateful, V. I've managed to reestablish contact with the vehicle. I'm sending a tow truck and a share of your fee. Yet only one of those is going to your credit account! :D
That's what it's all about! One less Tyger in this town. Appreciate your problem-solving skills, V. Gig closed.
Sincerest thanks for your assistance, V. I've taken the liberty to send you a share of your fee.
My, what a big rat you brought me! Bit surprised you didn't put her outta her misery. Well, least the vermin's off the street. Gig shut and closed.

My sincerest gratitude, V. All of my missing assets have returned to the fold. You might say all is going swimmingly. I ask you, please, to stop by my office for your hard-earned reward! I'd love to thank you face to face, so to speak.
b@d's happy, which means I'm happy, which means you get your eddies and everyone's happy! Contract closed. Thanks, V!
Well, Roh's secure, but I dunno... Guess I was expecting something more? Like more discretion? Next time, try and go that extra mile, 'K? Gig closed.
Sig reached me that Roh's secured. Can't say I'm not impressed. You handled it like a real pro. Closing the gig, sending the eds.

Vega's takin' a little nap in the trunk, no civs hit – yeah, knew you were the right one for the job. Very soon Vega will learn his actions bear consequences. I'll teach him that personally. Pro bono. Nice work, V. All Night City thanks you. Gig closed and sealed.
I'm afraid it is still too early in the testing process to say. But I would very much enjoy discussing the matter in my office; sending text-based messages feels so very impersonal.
How's it going with your wayward cabs? You know what happened?
Jacob got his eye back, so I'm closing this gig, but V... we both know that wasn't top-quality work. Maybe try a little harder next time, OK? Gig closed. And thanks.
I've just reestablished contact with the missing vehicle. Splendid work, V, first class. I shall forward a share of your fee.
Done and dusted. Jacob sends you his heartfelt thanks. Gig closed.
How fortunate, I've re-linked to the vehicle. Thank you! A share of your fee is in your account.

Poof! No more lab! Just like the doctor ordered. 'Course, let's not kid ourselves. Glitter's here to stay. But at least we hit the fuckers makin' it right where it hurts. Oh, one last thing – Arati asked me to thank you for her, said she's very grateful. So, thanks. Catch you later.
Was I speaking in tongues, V? I said no blood, not among civs. They've suffered enough. Although the end can justify the means, sometimes. Let's hope that's the case here. Contract closed.
It is not up to you, V, to decide a sinner's fate. We'll have to tell the client that Tucker disappeared. Then we can only hope she never returns to the city. Contract closed.
So, don't want to dirty your hands, trouble your conscience? Understood, V. Tucker Albach will have her Judgement Day yet. I'll see to it. Contract closed.
OK, I know Hal's secure, but let's not pretend it went smoothly. I expected you to be more professional, V. Please, no more stunts like that in the future. Closing the gig.
And the spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he went down to Ashkelon and slew thirty men... plus Tucker Albach. Well played, V. Bloody but efficient. Closing the contract.
Nicely done – Hal's very happy, talks about you non-stop. Only good things, of course. And remember, V – word gets around. Closing the gig.

In trust and secrecy lies our strength. Trust and secrecy. And here you simply show up at Tucker's, then leave? For what? For her to patiently await your return, hm? No. Now Tucker knows she's being hunted. No more secrecy… no more trust. Next time, realize your actions carry consequences.

What the hell happened? I already sent the car! Do the words "for the public good" mean anything to you, V? 'Cause what you pulled back there – that shit was the opposite of good. Those people have suffered enough. Christ… But at least Vega's fuckin' dead. Gig closed.
Hal's dead, V. Tried to make it out on his own, but that poor girl with cyberpsychosis got to him first. That was the fate you left him to when you abandoned him. I won't forget this.
I can truly count on you, V. The guitar is in the right hands – securely now. Closing this contract and transferring your compensation.
Fucked it up, V. Forget about the eddies. You're lucky you dont owe me now. Bye.
Flawless, V – all according to plan. Glad I can count on you. Contract closed.
Van received. Textbook example of a job well done, don't ya think? A plus plus – contract closed.

Hey, I already sent the car. You were just supposed to knock Vega out, toss him in the trunk. I know the scopsucker deserved to die, but… well, at least there wasn't any collateral damage. Community's suffered enough as it is. Gig closed.
Ya messed up, V. Meaning Hwangbo took a hit, and so did my rep. Not cool. Make sure it doesn't happen again. Closing the contract.
I have the rods, which makes me a happy man. And that is rare, V. Rarer than the rain on the Egyptian desert over which Moses wandered. But I digress. The contract is closed, payment on its way.
Flawless work, V. Hwangbo thinks your nickname should be the "Mad Lioness" so I guess he's happy. Closing the gig, sending you the cred.
entries.maleVariant: Flawless work, V. Hwangbo thinks your nickname should be the "Furious Lion" so I guess he's happy. Closing the gig, sending you the cred.

entries.femaleVariant: Excellent. The car has reached its owner – now the money will reach you. Good deeds are always repaid in kind. Closing the contract. Until next time.

Do the words "for the public good" mean anything to you, V? 'Cause what you pulled back there – that shit was the opposite of good. Those people have suffered enough. Christ… But at least Vega's fuckin' dead. Gig closed.
V, I trusted you, and you failed me. I believe we both stand to learn from this. Go with God.
Great work, V. Let's hope it helps trace the motherfucker who scrolled the thing. Gig's closed.
Vega's flatlined and no one else is, so I'll chalk that up as a "win." Community's suffered enough as it is. Gig closed.
Got the files from the Dicky Twister. I rejoice, and so should you, for the contract has been closed and your compensation is on its way. Amen.

Forget something, V? Like, I dunno, the scroll? No way we track down the original now. You burned our only lead. This was an important contract, one I needed to go well. V, I… These're bad optics. I'm used to working with professionals.
Got the data. Thanks, V. Gig closed.
Thanks for the shard! Sure it'll come in handy. Gig closed.

A gig well done, V. Our client's satisfied not only to get his hands on that recording, but the wheels too. A satisfied client means a satisfied fixer. Hell, you should be satisfied too. Contract's closed and payment's on its way.

The gig's done. Good. But you had a chance to get those wheels back and you didn't. Shame. A satisfied client means a generous client, and a generous client means a generous fixer. Try to remember that. Contract closed.

V, I… I understand your decision, but you could've handled that differently. Aaron was a bastard, but a bastard with influence. And you had dirt on him. But what's done is done. Our client's dead and gone which means so's our payment – you understand. Gig shut and forgotten.

Ugh... Well, this situation took a rough turn. But thanks for a job well done, V. And don't worry about Aaron. Let him sleep it off. When he wakes up, he'll remember we have the recording, and then, well… Then we've got our own inside source at the NCPD. Gig shut and sealed.
Aaron's happy. I'm happy. Always pays to be on good terms with badges, right? Gig's closed, eddies on their way.
Thanks for the help! Glad you got through to that stubborn mule. Looks like I'm up to bat with him now. Gig closed.
Obviously, I know Max is safe, but... from his state I can tell there were some complications. Ehhh... guess that was to be expected... Contract shut.
I know about Max. I know what happened. Been wondering what to say, what words would hurt the most. But you know what? Not worth it. I should've known a merc like you wouldn't be up to the task.

I know about Max – that you left him there. This was the one real chance to help, but now… you scared him off. To hide somewhere else. Corpos will probably track him down before I can. Guess you can work out what that means…
Things kinda took a shitty turn at the end there, huh? S'OK, shake it off this time. Can't predict the future, right? Happens to the best. Contract closed.

V, gotta admit – I'm impressed. Things got dicey at the end there, coulda gone tits up in a hurry. But hey, client's still breathing and so are you. I'll arrange a safehouse for Karl to sit tight in. Guessing he'll gladly front the extra bill. Slick work, really.
Package received. Thank you, V. Keep up the good work. The streets will remember your name.
Got the files from the Dicky Twister. I rejoice, and so should you, for the contract has been closed and your compensation is on its way. Amen.
Excellent. Sometimes equilibrium demands sacrifices. Contract closed.
Those who exact justice do so on behalf of our Lord. You've done well, V. I know this isn't always easy, and that's why I applaud your decision today. Contract closed.

Another sinner finds himself in the place he belongs. A trunk. Gustavo now suffers the purgatory he deserves. And perhaps has a moment to examine his conscience. Let's hope he finds it before the trunk opens back up. This concluldes our contract.

Gustavo Orta is dead. Killed by his own hand. How did you get him to do it? Or, actually, no… Don't tell me. She who reveals her secrets erodes her own trustworthiness and reputation. What's important is the result I asked for is the result I received. Contract closed.
entries.maleVariant: Gustavo Orta is dead. Killed by his own hand. How did you get him to do it? Or, actually, no… Don't tell me. He who reveals his secrets erodes his own trustworthiness and reputation. What's important is the result I asked for is the result I received. Contract closed.

entries.femaleVariant: You had an opportunity to free Gustavo Orta from sin. But you left him there. This man will now live to avoid the consequences of his actions – that is, until Judgment Day comes. We didn't want to wait that long. Remember – God takes note of your transgressions. As do I.

Gustavo Orta is dead. Killed by his own hand. I don't know what you told him, but I see he came to understand the gravity of his sin and sought out the justice he deserved. And you walk away with a clear conscience, no? Contract closed.

Calling all NCPD subcons. Suspected organized crime activity reported on Carnitas Street. Sixth Street Gang has established a presence led by Olga Elizabeth Longmead, wanted for kidnapping and first-degree murder, two counts. NC authorities have posted a reward for neutralizing the threat in that area.
"And you will know I am the Lord when I lay My vengeance upon you." And thus Karubo Bairei came to know the Lord's wrath through His humble servant. Excellent work, V. The contract is closed.

To all NCPD subcons – suspected organized crime activity reported near intersection of Sequoia and Gray. APB out on Paul Craven. Priors include corporate convoy hijacking. Also a known leader within an NC human trafficking ring. Active affiliations include the Wraiths gang. City authorities have offered a reward for neutralizing the threat.
Thanks to you, I'll be the one taking Karubo on his journey from our earthly plane... Closing the gig. Praise be to thee, V.
I already see Karubo in the fiery jaws of Hell, I hear his piercing screams, I smell the sinner's burning flesh. In other words, my heart is full of joy. Contract closed. Go with God.

APB to all NCPD subcons. Suspected organized crime activity reported on Pacific Boulevard. Anton Kolev, a known leader among scavengers, believed to be present and wanted on four counts of first-degree murder. Night City authorities have promised a reward for neutralizing Kolev and his entourage.
You're an angel sent from heaven, V. The daemon-possessed shard's on its way to the client, just like your money's on its way to you. Closing the contract.

Attention all NCPD subcons. Suspected organized crime activity reported around Eden Beach Mega Ride. Stanislaus Zbyszko likely at the scene. Perp is a known captain among scavengers with multiple smuggling priors. City authorities have a reward on offer for neutralizing Zbyszko and his group.
I pay you to fix problems, not create them. Remember that, V.
V, the point was to return the car in good condition. Yes, the nomads will handle it, but it would have been nice if it wasn't so beat up. Regardless, I'm closing the contract.

Calling all NCPD subcons. Suspected organized crime activity reported on Skyline South. Group of Valentinos led by Zoe Alonzo at large. Her record includes armed robbery, extortion, kidnapping and first-degree murder. Night City authorities offering a reward for neutralizing Alonzo's criminal network.
Sublime work, V. I knew I could count on you. The nomads are grateful for your help. Contract closed.

Calling all NCPD subcons. Suspected organized crime activity reported on Martin Luther King Boulevard. Members of the Valentinos engaged in smuggling and trafficking operations. Group is led by Miguel Rodriguez, AKA "Gizmo." Priors include second-degree murder and drug trafficking. City's put out a reward for neutralizing the threat.

Hear that? It's the sound of a slow clap for the spectacular mess you made. That car was worth quite a sum, and since "someone" went and totaled it – that someone won't be getting paid for their work.

You just raked in a hefty heap of eddies and have those Animals seein' red. See, I like folks who know how to leave a lasting impression. Think I'll close this contract and hold onto your number for a while.

Calling all NCPD subcons. APB out on suspected organized crime activity over on Sycamore Street. Due to nonpayment of rent and related fees, Night City has terminated its lease agreement with Impala Automatics for industrial property owned by the city. Impala Automatics has failed to comply with the decision and now illegally occupies the premises specified in the contract. City authorities have offered a reward for the successful eviction of Impala Automatics.

Calling all NCPD subcons. Suspected organized crime activity observed in the region of Goldsmith Street. Scavenger presence reported, led by one Barry Alken, wanted on charges of first-degree murder and illegal trade in cyberware. NC authorities offering payment for neutralizing Alken and his accomplices.

Attention all NCPD subcons. Suspected organized crime activity reported at corner of Drake and Cartwright. Tyger Claw gang members suspected of armed robbery and extortion are at the scene. Leader is Mokomichi Yamada, AKA "Motor Boy." City's put up a reward for the removal of Yamada and his accomplices from the area.

Attention all NCPD subcons – suspected organized crime activity reported off Willow Street. APB out on one Shinobu Imai, convicted on multiple counts of human trafficking and forced labor. City officials offering a reward for neutralizing Imai's criminal network in the Willow Street area.

Attention all NCPD subcons. Suspected organized crime activity reported near I-9. Perps in question tied to a series of robberies in the Badlands. Group is led by Bruce Ward, affiliated with the so-called Wraiths gang. NC authorities have offered a reward for neutralizing the threat.

Attention all NCPD subcons. Suspected organized crime activity reported on Sage Gulch Road. Warrants issued for Rufus McBride on counts of practicing as a ripperdoc without a license. Record shows three counts of causing permanent disabilty and one count of aiding in the staging of a suicide. Perp is in hiding among members of the Wraiths gang. City is offering a reward for neutralizing the threat and the group concealing him.

All NCPD subcons – APB out for suspect accused of organized crime activity near Ross Street and Shipyard Way. Scavengers led by Yelena Sidorova – presumed to be armed and dangerous – have assaulted multiple homeless persons. Night City officials are offering a reward for neutralizing the threat.

Calling all NCPD subcons. Suspected organized crime activity reported over on Richmond Street. Intel indicates Maelstrom gang members dealing in illegal stimulants in the area. They're led by Tom Ayer, AKA "Ymir", a known serial killer. Night City authorities have offered a reward for neutralizing the group.

Attention all NCPD subcons – organized crime activity reported on Martin Street. Maelstrom has established a presence in the area. Kaiser Herzog, AKA "The Surgeon," spotted. Priors include practicing as a ripperdoc without a license and first-degree murder, for which he has been sentenced to death. City authorities are offering a reward for the removal of Herzog and Maelstrom from the area.

Attention all NCPD subcons, APB out for suspected organized crime activity on Skyline South. Primary target is Denzel Cryer, AKA "The Brain." Cryer leads a subgroup of the so-called Animals gang, known to traffic the illegal supplement commonly called "juice." City's got a reward on offer for neutralizing Cryer and his entourage.

Attention NCPD subcons. Suspected organized crime activity reported on Hargreaves Street. APB out for Darius Miles, wanted for murder. Perp belongs to Sixth Street Gang and leads one of its drug-manufacturing rings. The city has promised a reward for terminating the threat from Miles and his drug cell.
Well done, my dear. I am pleased. As they say, we will be in touch. Contract closed.

You let the target die, V. Indeed, accidents happen – nothing will change that now. But do you know where the true problem lies? You let me down, V. You were reckless, just as all of my husbands once were. Now they are dead. So long, V.
Discreet and with finesse – something I cannot say about Mr. Gutierrez's divorce. Marvellous work, V. Closing the contract.
Perhaps you are not aware, but raising the alarm and discretion are not the same thing. Keep that in mind for the future. I am closing the contract.
I have received information that Vortex's shard is on its way. You did not disappoint, V. That deserves compensation. I am closing the contract and transferring your fee.
I see you do not ask unnecessary questions, V. You simply do what is asked of you. I admire such an approach, and I know how to compensate it. Contract closed.

You would be the last person to get bought by a corpo stuffed in a trunk. Or so I thought. You never fail to surprise, V. Though I do suppose he who offers most shall get his way. Oh, I do not mean Sergei. No, sadly he was outbid by another interested party. Who knows what will become of him now... Quid pro quo, V. Quid pro quo. Contract closed.
My dear V, you have disappointed me. What use is there in that? Next time, think before you act – otherwise you gamble with my temper. It is a losing game. Talk soon, V.
Lauren is secure – I am informing Bradley now. Thank you for your help. Contract closed.
You were to do this quietly. It was anything but. The whole city heard what happened in the shrine. Your payment will reflect your carelessness. I am closing the contract.
You entered and left like a ghost, V. Nobody at the shrine even knew of your presence. Excellent work. Closing the contract and making the transfer.
I was informed of how you handled yourself. Good work – I expected nothing less from you. I am closing the contract.
I see you were able to find the lockbreaker. Splendid work – keep it up. Closing the contract.

There is not enough free space to save game and application data on your Xbox console.\nDelete some of your data to free up space and try again or continue without saving.
So, V, the beta acid's secure? Padrísimo. And I'm puttin' you down for ten bonus points for solvin' the mystery of Booker's fate. It's clean work, V. Contract's closed, gratitude's on the way.
Well, I have the beta acid, but still got no clue what happened with Booker. Expected more from you, V. Closing this one and filing it under "Meh..."
Hey, just got intel that Logan Garcia's knockin' at the pearly gates. Client's very happy, and so am I. Closing the contract and sending the green your way.
Hey, just got intel that Logan Garcia's on his way to me now. Preemest of the preem. Tied this gig up real nice, V.
Beautiful work, V. Stove's finished even if he don't know it yet. Big thanks. Contract's closed and the eddies're flyin' at ya.
Preem work. Ted's gonna shit so hard on those Kendachi fucks. They won't know what hit 'em. Anyways, respect for running a tip-top op. Closing the contract and releasing your eddies.
Gig's done. Ted's got all the dirt on Kendachi he needs. That said, V... I gotta give you a C minus for effort. Closin' the contract, but I can't say I'm happy about it.

Humor me for a sec... How do you plant a bug under a truck that you blew to pieces, hm? Oh, that's right – you don't! What the hell's gotten into you, V?! Someone pinch me 'cause I must be dreamin' – I mean, who pulls this kinda shit?!
Heh, y'know, it's after gigs like this I think to myself, "Shit, am I glad I got V." Keep up the preem work. Closing the gig.
Profesh as ever, V! Sixers'll think twice before sliding their gonk asses anywhere near my turf again. And that thing with Lucius Thoran? Hm-hm-hm! Cherry on top! Contract ca-losed!

Looks like the Sixers learned their lesson... Can't say the same for our lucky choom, Lucius Thoran. But hey, guess I can't complain, right? Job's done, matter's resolved. Just, y'know, try to go that extra mile next time, 'K?

Well, well! Got ourselves a real edgerunner, huh? You lunatic! Waitin' and baitin' the corpos like that! Hah! I fucking love it! 'K, back to biz. Pedro's happy, so we're golden. Eddies flowing to your account now. Gig's closed.
Beautifully done, V. Dunno about Pedro, but I consider you my hero already. See, V? Play your cards right, you'll always walk away with full pockets. Closing the gig.
Jesus, V, what a shitshow! The gig, the client, the eddies, V! Down the drain – all of it! Don't even get me started on the wheels! Just... grrr!
V, you were supposed to get Jasmine to the ride. The chick's in shock – she doesn't know up from down! What if she made a wrong turn or-- Look, you're lucky she made it, OK?
Solid work, V. Jasmine's on her way to her dearest husband. Shit, think I might even cry. Job well done, V. Closing the gig.

Not good, V. Not good at all. Flavio's worm-chow and what's worse – my street cred took a hit. And you know there's nothing worth more to a fixer than their cred. I'm not the vindictive type, so I'll let this slide. But I've got a good memory – consider this strike one. Next time better be a home run.

Now that's what I call pro mercwork! Flavio's yappin' my ears off, says he's never met anyone tougher than you. Bet it's gonna stay that way for a while. Rare breed – mercs like you. Contract's closed, already flicked the eds your way.
You did it, V! Just got word that virus is blazing toward the servers like a fucking asteroid! Preem work, and thanks. Closing the gig.

Hey, V. Need a favor, choomba. Wanna hold a clearance sale - no junk, preem merch only. You know me. Problem is, hardly no one else does. Business is slow, gotta find new customers! Oh, and one more thing... The shooting competition, remember? I'm still waiting. Drop by the shooting range and later, we'll talk biz, okay?

About that sale, V – the shop's closed until the competition's over. Not happy about that, but a man's only got one pair of hands, you know? So drop by the shooting range and we'll talk biz when the shooting stops.
Hey, V. Got a job for you. Corner of Grey and Mallagra. Be there first thing in the morning, we'll talk it over.

I'm fucking livid, V! Those Us Cracks bitches clearly didn't get the hint. Instead of cancelling after we blew up their truck, they just moved their show to another date! Meet me at Riot ASAP. We'll deal with them differently this time.

The Us Skanks still wanna fuck me over and record the cover, V! On top of that, their lawyers won't stop yappin'. We really need to talk. I'm at Dark Matter right now. Come 'round the back, the bouncers will let you in.
It's easier to reach my dead grandma than you, V! Anyway, Us Cracks are done, for real this time. We should celebrate! Stop by Dark Matter. Use the back entrance.
V! Whatever you're doing right now – drop it and come see me at the Marina. Pier four.
Hey. I hear a war vet's barricaded himself at home, neighbors heard shots. Could be a cyberpsycho – figure out the sich and keep me posted, OK?
V, seems the Tygers might have cyberpsycho on their hands, one of their own. Check it out.
V, a few Zetatech corpos walked into an auto shop. The punchline – none came back out. Want you to figure out why.
V, near the GIM there's this walkway where people're fallin' off the map. Find out what's goin' on, and don't you disappear too.
Hey, V, Caught wind of a cyberpsycho at the docks. Wanna know if drugs played any part. A cold body's no good to check, so keep him alive.

Hey V, Frank here. From Arasaka. Abernathy's purging the dep, and I'm on her list. Not about to wait around for the executioner here. I'm putting together a file to fuck up her life. If I don't manage to make use of it... well, you'll get this message and the coords. I know you'll know what to do with em.
Hey V. Feel like swinging by Joss's for dinner?
Thanks for the invite, but have to catch you next time.

Tired of receiving those pesky vehicle-for-sale messages? We hear you! From now on, whenever you want to buy a vehicle, go to the Autofixer netpage on any computer. Once you're there, simply select the car or motorcycle you want, wire us the eddies and enjoy your new ride! It will immediately become available on your vehicle selection screen.
Gotcha. Well, just gimme a call if you change your mind, k?

My clients don’t need to kick the tires or peek under the hood. They know Muamar “El Capitan” Reyes already did it for ‘em! And to make everyone’s lives even easier, I set up my AUTOFIXER netpage! Just click, check the pics and choose your car – meanin’, if you can – and then shoot me the cred and full speed ahead! Just two things: no reservations, no installments.

Listen, cars are like underwear. I mean, you don’t gotta change ‘em every day... but it’s better for everyone if you do! Got a few new sets up on my netpage – talkin’ wheels, not tightie whities. Head on over to AUTOFIXER and grab a different model for each day of the week!

You gotta have a passion in life. Mine’s cars. I know you feel me. Why I’m tellin’ ya first - got a few new ones up on my netpage. Go on, check out what El Capitan’s got to offer. I mean it’s givin’ me chills just writin’ about  ‘em!

Funny sitch today. Was bringin’ a new car to my garage when the cops stopped me. Well, I lower the window and the pig goes to me: “Oh... sorry chief, my bad.” Now THAT’S what a car from AUTOFIXER can do for YOU! Wanna see what’s new? That’s what the netpage is for!

Used cars, man, they got a soul. All that talk about odometers being scrolled back, well, that ain’t nothing but a myth. Hell, I usually crank ‘em up – I mean, nobody’d believe me otherwise. Head over to AUTOFIXER and check the fresh wheels I caught!

Talk about an automotional connection. There’s days when I don’t know how I’m feelin’... till I grab the keys to a Shion instead of a Galena or Apollo and drive! Somethin’ tells me you’re the same. Hop on my netpage - AUTOFIXER’s got a few newbies to suit any mood.
You might not change the world, but you can still switch up your car! El Capitan is here to help! Fire up AUTOFIXER and peep the new rides waitin’ for ya in my garage!

Psst! Got a Quadra Type-66 Cthulhu screechin’ onto the AUTOFIXER netpage. Fun fact, in this car objects are NOT closer than they appear in the mirror – they’re left in the dust! That a trick of the light? Nah, it’s a miracle of automotive design. Grab your eds and hop on the site before the servers conk out.

Got a limited-time offer for a limited-edition Quartz Bandit. Took a little elbow grease to get all the dead flies off her windows, but she’s clean as a whistle now. Tossed a pic of the little beaut on AUTOFIXER. Go on, grab ‘er... and no need to thank me!
Me too, but now's not the best time.
Sorry, but definitely another time, yeah?
