Got word of a cyberpsycho attack, all confirmed. Even reported to MaxTac. Thing is, nobody's gonna show cause Militech shut it right down. Psycho's gotta be one of theirs. My eddies are on Lieutenant Mower. Anyway, corpo's gonna go straight into treatment. So make very, very sure you keep her in one piece.
Padre's closest companion. Judge, jury and executioner for divine justice – all rolled into one.
As mean throughout all Night City as it is on the streets of Santo.
Spent most of the time collecting dust on Wakako's desk. Except for the occasional heated negotiation.
V, there's a cyberpsycho out in the Badlands, hanging around some truck full of cyberware. Go check it out.
Hey, heard about a massacre at a homeless camp. Send you the info I have so far... and yeah, it's a cyberpsycho.
V, heard Northside's seein some action,  got Maelstromers haulin ass outta there. Go see what's goin on exactly.
The pride of Serbia's arms industry. So yeah, like kinda above average.

I keep wondering if I should just keep it for myself… The Quartz is a legend in its own right, but the Quartz "Bandit" is the motherf&#@ing holy grail of collector's items. This limited edition is so limited that nobody even knows how many were manufactured. Apparently Billy "Bandit" McCarty calls Archer up every day just to listen to that beast of an engine purr. Well the folks at Archer did him one better - they hired the lunatic.\n\n If you've got any functioning brain cells left in that noggin of yours, you'd snap this up in less than a heartbeat.

Did you know that the Quadra Type-66 can stay still faster than other cars actually drive? Fact. You a racer? No? 'Cause with this ride, you will be. Fact. Just remember to invest in some tough-ass brakes when you're tuning her up.

Low mileage – guy who owned it for the last ten years was paranoid of going outside cuz he was afraid "they" would zero him – car sat unloved all that time. But you can't escape fate, right? Stray lead caught him through his window. Moral of the story's that you gotta grab life by the balls. So don't be no scrooge, whip out your credchip and buy this baby before the same happens to you!

Dissing your own wares isn't exactly preem marketing strategy, but Muamar "El Capitan" Reyes will always give it to you straight. We all know a Mahir Supron looks like a group of hobos glued together a bathtub and a trashcan and slapped on some dinner plates for wheels.\n\nIt gets you from A to B, just don't expect anyone to drop their panties when you drive by. If you're just looking to drive your leaky-diaper granny to a ripper or your chooms to a shady deal, you ain't gonna feel bad about ditchin a Supron.

This used Columbus is just wasting away at a garage while it should be put to work. It belonged to my buddy who used to drive around town selling weed and shit. Don't really mind it myself, but if you prefer lavender over kush, better get yourself a different ride, know what I mean? Just being an honest salesman here. No BS.

Thorton Colby C125. Never been a station wagon man myself – typically only good for hauling around kids and caskets. But this one belonged to some carjacker from Memphis, a certain Nicholas, may he rest in peace.\n\nHe'd klep the preemest wheels for rich buyers – you know, Rayfields, Herreras – but for years his own personal ride of choice was this Colby. I could tell you why, but I'd rather you got behind the wheel and experienced it for yourself.

Makigai MaiMai P126 - cute car looking for a good home! She's sweet, pothole-trained and great with kids. Very few accidents, generally gets along well with other vehicles on the road. She'll help you make friends and even land some dates. But be warned: as small as she is, she knows how to put away the CHOOH2. I honestly don't know where it all goes.

Ever wanted a yacht but too fuckin scared of the ocean? Same, choom, same. That's where this Valentino-pimped beauty comes in. Picture it - a sunny day in Heywood, cruisin the block in this preem-ass Chevillon Thrax 388 Jefferson, windows down, woofer bumpin... Yeah, you can smell the respect, right?\n\nSo either keep jackin off into your PJs watchin skindances at home, or buy the ride that'll change your sad fuckin life forever. The choice is yours, amigo.

Thorton Colby CX410 Butte - perfect for hauling old rugs to the landfill and dropping off your chooms for a swim in the bay. If that's the utility you need, look no further. One side note - maybe you're a painter and have a nasty habit of spilling red paint, the best thing I found works on this car is a mix of one part water to one part vinegar. It smells like a pickle jar after but hey, pigs eat donuts not pickles.

The Villefort Cortes V5000 Valor represents the very soul of American engineering. Impressive and dignified. A kid from a wealthy family got it for his birthday but never drove it. He preferred to stay planted on the couch, jacked into BDs and snorting lines off the tits of his harem of sexbots. When the kid's folks finally disinherited the "little parasite" and kicked him out, they pawned off the car to my humble garage.\n\nThis is a real steal of a deal so don't let anyone else snatch it up before you.
V, you know wild screamin' at Totentanz isn't headline news. Could just be some screamo band's set rehearsal... That, or somethin' a shade more sinister.
V, shit went down at a construction site downtown. My money's on another cyberpsycho attack. Go check it out for me.

Thorton Galena "Gecko" up for grabs. If you're a nothing-beats-the-original type of person either stop readin or get a fuckin brain. Your standard Galena's decent, sure, but nomad techs breathed a new life into this ride I didn't think possible. Interior's rough around the edges (no cup holder, entertainment system, heated seats, etc. etc.) but it kicks like a shot of Centzon and its suspension is damn near indestructible. Handles great off road and can clear any dune or incline, making this Galena great for shaking tails. If all else fails, the mounted leadspitter should convince them otherwise. If you want a reliable partner for the road ahead, you've found it.
Hey, Raffens are hunting someone out in the Badlands. Heard it might be a cyberpsycho. Try and get there first, and as usual – try and get 'em alive, too.

Yaiba Kusanagi CT-3X – Say goodbye to traffic jams, say hello to style. Ever wanted to feel the rush of riding an ICBM into the sun? No? Too weirdly specific? Trust me, choom - take this baby for a drive at sunset and see what I mean.

Archer Quartz EC-T2 R660. Well maintained, every inch polished to a shine. The previous owner said he'd miss his "baby" and "dream car". Spit shine, elbow grease, you name it - this guy put his whole being into this car. His wife not so much. She said "it's me or the car", blah blah blah, one divorce later and our guy's knee deep in legal fees, forced to sell. Won't find another set of secondhand wheels in this preemo condition. BUY NOW!

Thorton Colby "Little Mule" up for sale. Nomad engineering is guided by one simple principle: pragmatism.  Nomad-altered vehicles are built for taking beatings, not pretty pictures. Hell, they'll probably outlive us all - our enemies included, 'cause this Colby comes with a mounted machine gun. One thing's sure - you won't find anything more reliable for a trek across desert wasteland.

Chevillon Emperor 620 Ragnar – a tank made for city driving. But don't get scared off by its intimidating design. This SUV is spacious yet cozy, and sports a suspension system made of cotton candy and teddy bears. Why waste time getting your ass oiled up at a massage parlor when this rig does the same job with less the mess?

The Mizutani Shion "Coyote" is a beast most at home roaming the Badlands. It may churn out smoke like a dragon, but it handles just as smooth over rusty nails and broken glass as it would the smoothest highway. Did I mention it pumps lead, too? It's only as accurate as its trig-puller, but I'm sure you're up to the task.\n\nIf you're crazy for the Coyote, wire me those eddies and get ready to feel the sand in your hair.

Villefort Alvarado V4F 570 Delegate – Someone offers you 4 eddies or 6, which you takin? OK, now how bout a ride with 4 wheels or 6? Exactly ;) It ain't a hard choice so don't make it one, ey?\n\nThis Alvarado's in great condition, once owned by a Valentino. That chico fucked up bad and made the wrong enemies - had to disappear, left town. Needed to travel light so he pawned everything he had. Nice guy I am I figured I'd share this gem with the world for a low, low price.

Just hear how nasty this beast roars and how sexy it purrs! The previous owner apparently had a thing for SoCal and 6th St by day and a laser-focused obsession with dominating the NC street race scene by night. That is, till he zeroed some corpo crossing the street in the wrong place at the wrong time. If that story sounds too apeshit crazy to be true, just remember this is Night City.\n\nGood news is the rig's still in tip-top shape and primed to perform. Bumper replaced, scrapes buffed and painted, blood washed off. 10/10 a must-buy.
A mod cannot be installed in an item of a lower Tier than itself.

~QUADRA AVENGER~ Absolutely INSANE ride fresh on the market! Sick upholstery, wicked paint job, and a brutal engine that ROARS like a lion! Yeah ok, maybe the battery's a little on the unreliable side, but c'mooon, don't fuck this up -- BUY NOW!!!

Looking for new wheels? One that won't choke on dust the second you cross the border? Then check out this Quadra Type-66 "Javelina". It's tuned up and tricked out by my good friend who handpicks the freshest nuts and bolts from the local mechanics' market. He's got an unmatched eye for quality, so satisfaction is guaranteed. Oh, he also tossed in preem-ass mounted rifle, free of charge. This ain't no car - it's a killing machine on wheels and every nomad's wet dream.\n\nIf you got the eddies, it's time to pony up.

Friends asked you out for a Friday night shootout but you're too broke to join them? Well, now you don't have to pass on the opportunity to enjoy their company! The Budget Arms Guillotine SMG has been created with moments like these in mind – it has a grip, a barrel, a magazine and a loose trigger for those unforgettable trigger-happy moments with your chooms.
Buy it at Wilson's Bangin' Sale or find it on the streets.
Brennan Apollo. City and desert driving. High utility, minimal frills. "Min. description length not met" ... Jesus christ... Reliable, powerful, nomad vibes. Buy it... Lalalalalalalalalala

Some people might claim Darra Polytechnic's Umbra is an unwieldy hunk of low-grade alloy that wouldn't last five minutes in a real firefight. Those people would be right. However, despite its drawbacks, the Umbra is growing in popularity – you can buy it minutes before a gig, get the job done and toss it in the sewer without a second thought. The Umbra is cheap enough for you to ruin someone's life without ruining your budget.
Buy it at Wilson's Bangin' Sale or find it on the streets.

Forget all those sissy cars, go for a heavyweight. Behind the wheel of a Mackinaw, there's no such thing as obstacles. Hell, maneuverability is overrated anyway. Ever use bumpers in bowling? That's what street lamps are for. This hunk of metal has many advantages but also one major flaw – it eats a heavy diet of CHOOH2.

There's little Johnny Silverhand loves more than the spotlight. However, it's not easy to enjoy that if you're just a construct in someone's head. Time to unleash your inner rockerboy with Johnny's new poses! Show the unbelievers that the rumors of his death have been greatly exaggerated.
Open Photo Mode while playing as Johnny.

If you want to be successful, you have to keep your eyes on the target. That is why we have prepared a range of weapon scopes to suit everyone's needs and budgets. If you're on the rise, you can afford the slick beauty and functionality of Arasaka, Tsunami or Kang Tao scopes. However, if you're against paying big money to even bigger corporations, get yourself a scope custom-made by one of Night City's countless iron techies.
Buy it at Wilson's Bangin' Sale or find it on the streets.

Some mercs say that in order to make it in this biz, you have to take off the muzzle and forget about the brakes. While that may be true in a metaphorical sense, actual muzzle brakes can save your life. These babies greatly reduce weapon recoil, which translates to better gun control and more precision.
Buy it at Wilson's Bangin' Sale or find it on the streets.

Won't lie, this Mizutani Shion might be a refurb – the chick who owned it liked to lead-foot the pedal – but the engine, suspension, brakes, everything that matters is in preem condish. Rides like a pure dream. This baby's a classic, and a fast one at that – perfect for losing the 5-0. Oh, and the flooring might be a little stained. Coffee...? Blood? Hard to tell, I'm color-blind.

Now something for those who know what's goin on and can spot a real opportunity when they see it. I'm selling a Herrera Outlaw - a real rare and precious commodity. About a 1000 or so left in the world, maybe a dozen of these drivin round NC.\n\nIf you got the scratch, snag it before someone else does or find yourself crying in that stinkin piece of junk you call your car now. It's time for a change. Stop skimpin and join the elite ranks of Outlaw owners.

I have a Quadra Turbo for sale, but I suspect it will not stay available for long, since it is a good machine and there is no shortage of buyers. If life has taught me anything, it is to seize an opportunity as soon as it appears, for it might only appear once. You can think about that while you gather the money to pay.

I have an ARCH Nazaré's that is looking for a new owner – practically new. It once belonged to a corpo who wanted to impress his minions... except he did not have the first clue about handling it. He braked a little too hard and launched himself into the air – skull smacked the pavement so forcefully that not even TT Platinum could save him. Thank God for idiots. So, are you ready to buy?

Got some eddies to burn? Maybe, I dunno, you'd consider buying a Caliburn? You heard right – A FUCKING CALIBURN! Beautiful machine, a downright work of art. If I could, I'd make love to this thing. Used to belong to Cytech's CEO, but the gonk sold it cuz apparently, and I quote, "Only poor people drive two-year old cars." Shit, I wish everyone could be poor by that definition. I just hope this Caliburn gets a loving owner, cuz she deserves it. If you're interested, lemme know.

This Rayfield Aerondight "Guinevere" belonged to the ambassador of Argentina... that is, until the country returned to martial law and the only thing waiting for him there was a noose, so he sold everything he could and fled the city. He didn't try to bargain with me – the sign of a smart man. I too would be smart if I were you and get your cash ready, because this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. The world ain't exactly teeming with these beauties.\n\nEveryone wants to be unique, stand out, be noticed – I know you do too. The Aerondight can make that happen.
Know what? I'm glad we got a chance to talk over coffee. You're a straight shooter, V. Nothing like the ass-kissers I'm usually surrounded by.
It's good we did what we did, right? Blowing that van to bits? Cuz I been thinking…
To be honest, got no clue if anything good will come of it.
It was the right thing to do.
Honest as ever, huh? Means I was right about you.
Nitro in my veins? Yeah, and a fuse sticking out of my ass. Least that's what I felt back then. Was worth it, though – slept like a fucking baby for the first time in ages.
Appreciate that, V. I really do. Don't ever change.
Talk to you later. Thanks again!
Check it out, V. Got this email from a lifelong fan. It's serious. Gotta write her back.

"Dear Mr. Eurodyne, the day we both have been waiting for is finally upon us! I got rid of my husband, my house and all the other remnants of my former life. Now, I'm truly ready to give you my heart and all my other organs, should you desire them. You are the Sun and I am the Moon – I live to bask in your radiant brilliance. I love you, Mr. Eurodyne, and eagerly anticipate the time we'll finally be together. We will meet soon – I'm sure you know exactly where."
She also sent me a gift card to a junk shop in Providence, wherever the fuck that is. It's clear she's nuts, just not sure if it's the murder-suicide variety.
She writes me same day every year, like clockwork. What if she dissolved her man in a vat of acid, burned down her house and now she's sharpening her sickle cuz I'm next!? What are we gonna do, V???
Fuckin preem. What should I do, V? Ideas??

Yeah, yeah, Kovachek usually deals with all that shit. Even signs photos and sends them to the fans. But the fucker always forwards stuff from this crazy broad. Gets his rocks off fuckin with my blood pressure.
Anyway, thought you might get a kick out if it. Seriously though, I should probably do something. Don't want her to knock on my bedroom door a year from now.

Kovachek went ballistic when he found out the yacht went up in smoke! Even went back on those pills that turn him into you know, whatever the opposite of a cyberpsycho is. More goo than a man haha this is greaaaaat!
Ouch. Musta sunk a lotta eddies into that float! :P
I really don't care about that dick, Kerry.
Fine OK. As long as you care about MY dick, that is :P
Speakin of dickheads tho – turns out he stashed a ton of drugs on board! Like, two yachts' worth. And we sent aaaall of that to the bottom of the sea :D
Bay's full of fish high off their fins now!
Literally zero living organisms in that bay, Ker.
Yeah duh they they took their happy fishy asses down to the spaceport and went to la la land.
Feel like blowing more of his shit up. Think he's got a luxury crib somewhere in the Rockies... Something to think about... :P
Anyway tellin ya whenever I'm down, I think about our seaventure and it's like insta good feels :*
FUCK NO! I GOT IT! We make a Kovachek voodoo doll! Can't wait to stab that prick right in the dick :D
I'm boooooooored, V. Let's play Truth or Dare! :D
Really don't have time for this, Ker.
Cmon, don't be like that. TRUTH or DARE???
OK, here it goes. Hope I got your full attention!
Here it goes: "After a little good morning sex, what I really want is..."
Cheeky ;) Guess I can give it a try ;)
Don't know if I have time for that, Kerry.
OKOK here's your dare: "Survive one year with a rockstar" :D
Coffee and cigarettes. Glass of whiskey if I need a little hair of the dog...
V! Made one of them picture riddles for you, V! Wanna see it? :D
Fuck yeah you do! Heeeere goes!
Not right now, Kerry. Got some other things on my mind...
Really, Ker? Doesn't take a rocket scientist to figure that one out.
No worries. Listen, we all have days like this. Thinking of you here with my little puzzle, hope that helps :*
Yeah, yeah, just warming up! Okay, get ready for round two!
Kerry slapped the shit out of Kovachek!
My man is shit at puzzles :*
Sorry, all you get is a kiss :*
You got it, you shrewd beast :D
Congrats! Your reward – a Kerry Eurodyne sextape!
Now all that's left is to shoot it :P
You're not gonna believe this, V. I took one of those personality tests and apparently, I'm a NARCISSIST! Can you believe that shit??
You, a narcissist? That can't be right.
Might be some truth to it if I'm REAL honest :)
I know, right? Good thing you're smart about these things.
You do... tend to be an arrogant snob. Not to mention your ego's the size of a small planet :*
Haha took the test again and now it says I'm a sociopath! Told you it's all bullshit!
Told you I'm not a narcissist! Honestly you should listen to me, I'm smarter than whatever "scientist" came up with this shit!
Maiko just called. We're all set.
This afternoon, out in front of H8. Assuming you'll be there?
Take care till then. And thanks... Again. It really means a lot to me.

El Capitan has done it again! The competition hates him! The people love him! Hop on AUTOFIXER – you won’t believe what you find! With El Capitan’s cars and AUTOFIXER, five minutes is all you need to make your automotive dreams come true! What are you waiting for?!
Wait, are you trying to sext right now?
Hmm... Wondering if I can do a double backflip with a full twist?
That if I were an animal, I'd totally be a dog.
Because in that case, I'd better find a nice quiet spot...
Mmm, think you should show me sometime ;)
Ain't nothin' like the real thing baybaaaay
Yeah, think I saw something like that in an old movie once. Super weird :/
Please, you know braindance gets the job done muuuuch better.
Ehhh, maybe it'll come back to me.
Now I forgot what I was gonna write.
You got it... Course, it's still not as good as realspace.
Aaaah, yeah, think I know the one. Classic. And yeah, nothin like the real thing ;)
OK gimme a sec, there's gotta be a joke about tongues and licking in here somewhere...
Anywho, enough distractions, back to work for me
Was just thinking if you were an animal, you'd be a dog.
Yeah, obvi... But you're also loyal. Woman's best friend and all that.
Yeah. And the best friend I've ever had.
You're complex, you contain multitudes, you can feel both at once.
Not sure if I should be blown away that you read my mind, or offended and disappointed at your crass attempt at a "joke"
Because I'm cute, loyal and love to lick eeeeeverything
A shot of vodka on the rocks, topped with NiCola. Aim high and go out with a bang.
Shit on a fucking shit cracker
OK so... I uh, I was talking to my grams and I accidentally told her about you
I'm just warning you, she might try to contact you... I'm sorry  -.-
Didn't give her your detes obviously, but she's got mad detective skills for her age. Honestly don't know how she does it. I'm so so sorry.
Haha big oops. You think it'll be that bad though?
Just picture the DataKrash, that's the sort of destruction she's capable of.
OK.... And I got my fingers crossed for ya
You do realize you can't shoot your way outta this one, right?
So I can't just ignore her, right?
Come on, no way it's that bad
Basically a 5 ft 2 pitbull trained in advanced interrogation techniques
But she's really sweet once u get to know her!
I mean you could try, but...
Yeah... positive thinking, that's the way.
I mean it, your little ol' abuela can't be that scary.
Let's just say you've been warned.
and let me knwo how it goes, ok?
Holy shit, Ainara Alvarez is one tough cookie
You weren't joking about your abuela
I know, just got off the holo with her
Just got off the holo with my grams
I think she's a bit sceptical.
Man if you two ever meet, it's gonna be good O_O
Don't think you two really hit it off
Thanks for talking to her, V.
I know she can be alot
Just talked to my grams wow is she pissed.
Take it you just blocked her?
I can't deal with this drama right now
Now I get why she compared you to Maiko
Listen... I know you got a lot on your plate right now. My abuela's not your top priority
Quit it with the charm bub
Awwwww my sweet little vulnerable leelou bean
But now I gotta go hide somewhere, I'm all flushed -.-
You're great. Just wanted you to know that.
and I wanna say thanks, V. For being with me, for everything you've done. And just for being you
Ok so you know I'm not great with feelings and stuff... But I've been thinking about the past few months
Shit, didn't realize how that sounded
And you just got burned. Bad. All you can do now is wipe your files, cover your tracks and flee this city of broken promises, never to return.
Just gotta get something off my chest
Sounds like the start of every breakup text I've ever gotten
I need to tell you something.
So you are the girl who is dating my Ranita, yes? Interesting.
My name's V. Nice to meet you.
Ranita's last girlfriend was one of those corporate types, too. She didn't leave a good impression on me.
Not with the corp anymore, ma'am.
You're a nomad, so I assume family is important to you. Why did you leave yours?
Needed a change, plus some clan infighting and a few really bad decisions.
I heard you are from Night City – born and bred as they say?
Left Night City for a bit, but now I'm back.
We seem to have some mutual acquaintances there.
Just didn't feel right anymore. It's complicated.
True, megacorps do tend to do that.
Burned me. Like they burn everyone eventually, I guess.
Well, Seattle is nice. But I'm sure it will soon turn out to be just another city with the same old problems.
Never thought I'd see a city as weird as this one, but Atlanta sure gave it a run for its money.
So you are a merc now. What is it exactly that you do?
Remember the attack on Arasaka Tower?
Right now? Just trying not to die
Can't talk about it. Top secret.
You attacked one of the most dangerous corporations in Night City.
I hope you're not getting my Ranita in trouble.
Not everything went according to plan on my last gig. So I'm cleaning up my mess.
Tell me. What are your intentions towards my granddaughter?
That's really between us, don't you think?
Think everyone just wants to find their happily ever after.
Trying my best not to mess things up.
If I thought that I wouldn't ask.
They do. And Judy deserves hers.
Take good care of my Ranita. I trust you.
We'll see what else I hear from you in the future. Or about you.
What happened to Juliet, V... Fuuuuuuck. She never mentioned she had a sister. It's a cryin' shame… Thanks for grabbin' that data, V. Gig's closed. I'll, uh... I'll be in touch.
Provocation. What now, you piece of filth?!
Provocation. I'ma tear you to shreds, scopsucker!
Provocation. You done messed with the wrong woman!
entries.maleVariant: Provocation. You done messed with the wrong choom!

entries.femaleVariant: Fun fact. The human body holds between five and seven liters of blood.
Fun fact. According to traditional Christian doctrine, you are going to burn in hell.
Fun fact. The vast majority of murders are committed by men. You go girl!
entries.maleVariant: Fun fact. The vast majority of murders are committed by men. Just like you!

entries.femaleVariant: Fun fact. Bloodstains can be removed using one easy trick and vinegar!
Fun fact. The human brain remains active for up to several minutes after decapitation!
Error – premature discharge. I'm sorry, this never happens!
Are you happy with the autonomous shooting function? Please jump to confirm.
Installing update. This may take several minutes…
Bum bum be-dum bum bum be-dum bum…
New magazine detected. Message to user. Thanks, choom!
Is there no end to this madness?!
A delay has occurred. Possible cause – power surge. Message to user – My bad.
Boooring! 'Sides, cops mean lawyers and I hate dealing with them even more than I hate Kovachek's guts. No worries, I'll think of something else.
Hahahaha you beautiful fucking GENIUS! Think I'll do exactly that. He'll shit himself when he sees her! We'll set up a camera and film it, too. Can't wait!
Smart! I'll see if they have anything worth my while. Get myself a studded choker. Or one of them Russian stacky doll-in-a-doll-in-a-doll things.
I agreed cuz you paid me.
And you've got nitro running through your veins. Don't you ever let yourself think otherwise!
More importantly: Kerry Eurodyne actually reads fan mail? Adorable.
Unbelievable :D Don't worry about it. We'll deal with her.
Let them scare her off? Or better yet, put her in a straitjacket?
Why not have a bit of fun? Write her back, give her Kovachek's address and say you'll be waiting for her there exactly one year from now :P
She probably thinks she's pregnant with Lizzy Wizzy's love child, too. Check if the store has a netpage, see if they ship to NC and get yourself something nice!

Hey! Just dropped by your place (and I'm the messy one, huh?) and left you a small gift – a vinyl with my cover of "Chippin' In."
It's a true collector's item – we pressed about a dozen of these bad boys to go with the premiere of "Second Conflict." Might catch one of these babies at auction going for sick eddies, but I left one for myself.
And now... it's yours :*

PS. Johnny probably thinks his version is better. Wouldn't be the first time he's wrong :P
Want this ride? Earn some Street Cred first.
Oh, you visited him at the hospital? What did he think of your gift?
Hi Randy! :P How is he? Getting better, I hope?
Loved it, actually. I mentioned it was your idea.
Well... He sure tried to look like he enjoyed it. Gotta sharpen up my uncling skills pronto.
Yeah, he gets stronger every day. You have no idea how grateful we are.
Always happy to help. With anything :)
Randy knows he can count on you That's what matters.
Randy's lucky to have a family like that.
Don't hesitate to hit me up. Whatever you need.
Randy knows he can count on you. That's what matters.
Randy's lucky to have a cool uncle!
Anything, you say? I'll keep that in mind :)
24/7? Don't think I won't pick you up on that!
By the way – I was at the hospital and met the parents of those two boys we'd saved at the farm. They wanted me to thank you.
Since we're exchanging niceties – I met the parents of those two boys we'd saved at the farm. They wanted me to thank you.
Shame we managed to save only two of them...
You shouldn't think like that. We did what we could.
Oh, and I also met with Yawen. You know, the one from the lab.
I know, the one who's your ex.
The lab? You'll have to refresh my memory.
Yawen Packard. She helped us with the Peter Pan case. My ex, remember?
Reigniting the old flame, are we?
You couldn't be more wrong. Someone else is on my mind these days.
Don't know about that. I feel like too much is happening right now to even consider it.
I thanked her for helping us with Harris. She risked her job back then. Sends her regards.
Right. And how did you "thank" her, exactly?
Good luck with that, River. She seemed like one of the good ones.
Oh my, V! Did I just smell a hint of jealousy there?
Maybe, maybe not, maybe fuck you? :P
Jealous? For you? Gimme a break :D
Haha! You have nothing to worry about, really. Promise. Hope to see you soon, V.
Not for me, for Yawen! She's a great catch – intelligent, stable job, doesn't leave dirty dishes in the sink... She's all yours for the taking! Seriously though, hope to see you soon. Take care, V.
So... Have a good one, V!
Time will tell. Keep your fingers crossed, anyway. I'll see you around.
You were in my dreams today, you know?

Whaddup, valued choom and customer! Lemme guess - STILL driving that old set wheels and bored out of your gourd? El Capitan's got you covered! Check out my new netpage AUTOFIXER (pretty slick name if you ask me) to find your new ride TODAY. Just click, pay and BOOM! Night City's streets are all yours. You demand – El Capitan supplies. Simple as that. WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? VISIT AUTOFIXER NOW AND BUY BUY BUY!!!
Don't think I wanna know the details XD
Hit me! Can't pass on an opportunity like that!
Don't know if I'm ready for that today.

Well, I woulda told you anyway. You were riding a motorcycle, jacked into it via smart link. Your every thought, every reaction were immediately picked up by the machine. Before a turn, the bike leaned to the side before you even thought about it. When you pushed on the throttle, it roared forward, eager to please and thrill you. Your thighs were clutching its metal body, your muscles pulsating with excitement as you dashed down the highway... You probably figured by now I was the bike in the dream. And then... then I woke up.
What do you think? Who haunted whom?
Who are you and what have you done to River Ward XD
Now I really wanna see that engine running ;)
It's as good as the rider :D
That bad, huh? Well, you win some, you confuse some :) Time to park the bike in the garage. FOREVER.
Hey, V. I could use your help with a tricky matter.
Don't worry, the only thing needs saving this time is my dignity. Remember when I told you I considered becoming a PI?
Course. Still hoping to see that private dick in private action ;)
Well now the private dick is blushing!
I'm gonna go for it. Feels like the right move for me. Combining the familiar with something new. And you played a part in it too, you know?
And not a small one at that! Which is why I'd like for you to pick a name for my new enterprise. Whaddya say?
I'm sure you can come up with a good one. It's your business, after all.
I will suggest the names and you pick one.
I'll help you, but I need a list of suggestions. Ain't great at marketing, you know.
I was actually counting on that. Got anything good?
How about "Warning Shot PI" or "NC Crime Ward?"
NC Crime Ward sounds good... How about "Private Sherlock?" :P
"Edgewood Findings PI." Or maybe "NC Crime Ward."
Oh, wow. Don't know what to choose now...
Night City Crime Ward. For sure.
Edgewood Findings Private Investigations. No doubt.
My Justice Private Investigations. Really like that one.
I do. A lot, actually. Just need to sleep on it now.
I got some options, now I have to sleep on them.
Could sleep with me, you know ;)
Was thinking the same thing ;) We're in touch!
I will. Unless I decide I don't like your suggestions, in which case I'll start actively avoiding you :P
Ugh. I'll bet your sweet ass I'm even worse at this!
Increases melee damage dealt to target enemy by {int_0}% for {int_1} sec. after hitting them with a thrown Knife.
Come on. I've seen how creative you can get. Help me out on this one. Please?
Headshots with thrown Knives apply Blinding to the target.
Fine. But I thought all those years of interrogating people left you with more wit than that :P
Give me your suggestions, I will pick the right one. Simple as that.
When you defeat an enemy or land a Crit Hit with a thrown Knife, you will regain all Knives currently on cooldown.
Phew. That's a load off my shoulders. I'll be waiting, then!
Damnit. Fine. I'll think about it.

Hey V, we buried our dead. Thought you'd like to know. Then Mitch took Scorpion somewhere out by some bridge, had a funeral of his own. All alone, too. I'm not sure why I'm writing you this, but... well, it's hard. For me and Mitch. For everyone.
About me and my goods, I hope?
So much thinking... Poor, dry River!
Laugh all you want. Thinking isn't exactly in the NCPD job description.
Okay, two ideas right off the bat: "River Ward Patrol" or "Detective Hunch Private Investigations." Thoughts?
River Ward Patrol is funny. I like it.
River... Ward... Patrol. It's not clear to you?
Suits your personality. Trust me on this, baby!
It really says everything about you, babe :)
Carries a promis of a genuine detective.
Right. Makes sense. Thank you, V, you helped me a lot!
Already mentioned that you deserve a lot of credit for all of this. But I'll understand if you don't want to have anything to do with it.
Look, I'm happy for you, setting up a new business and everything. But really, it's your future, you should be the one making important decisions like that.
Sorry, River. Don't really have the time for this right now.
Fine. I still like you, though.
I like you too, you big dummy.
Let me know what you decided on!
More "big" than "dummy," I hope! I'll keep in touch about this.

Hey! I talked to my neighbors today and I got really inspired. I think I got it. Ready? Here goes... "Your Super-Detective Companion." I'll get a big, old-fashioned signboard and everything. What do you think? It's great, right?
The name won't matter once they see that handsome face of yours ;)
...you're messing with me now, aren't you?
Now that's a good answer if I ever saw one! You deserve a special kiss for that :*
Hey, you're a super-detective to me! :*
I'm totally not! It really is perfect.
Damn, do I like you, girl :)
entries.maleVariant: Damn, do I like you, boy :)

entries.femaleVariant: Regenerate {int_0}% of all damage taken within the next {int_1} sec.
Guess what, V… Today, I founded my very own company! It's official!
Has a nice ring to it, don't ya think?
You - a merc. Me - a P.I. Quite the pair and not all that unalike. We help the client find what they can't find themselves.
Yeah, true. Easy to get lost in the details
Dunno… Somtimes its my job to keep things hidden
Exactly. And I'd rather not dwell on those details… Or the old cop in me is gonna get antsy
See? We complement each other. That's good business ;)
A merc doesn't always need answers. Sometimes we go in blind
A problem solved for one client raises a new problem for another

Well, not even the lucky ones get to work with complete info… Still, see what you mean. But if I'm looking for a missing person, it'd be good to know if they don't wanna be found. Like a woman fleeing her abusive husband.
Not sure you have any idea just how many enemies I made in my service with the NCPD. I know a thing or two about replacing old problems with new ones :)
But I gotta say. Bein a merc, having flexible hours is quite the perk
At least bein a detective means bein insured
So you're on call 24/7? Hey, if you like it… :D
Right! Thanks for the reminder. Knew I forgot something...

Btw, cross your fingers for me. Think I might have my first contract. Client has til the end of today to decide and give me the scoop. It's re: a disappearance, which is perfect. That's where I see myself focusing my effort.
Not gonna focus any of that effort on me?
Only without any repeats of Peter Pan I hope. Gotta watch your back
Hmmm… Now what could that mean… Wait, don't telll me, I'm a detective after all ;)
Nah, c'mon. Don't worry about little old me. Athough it is cute :)
Ever take a shower and just get lost in thought? Gonna be me today. Thinking about you…
Gonna miss hangin out while you're out there finding all the city's missing
Oooh… well if you do get lost, I'll be there to find you. ;) Unfortunately gotta put down my phone for a bit, but we'll talk soon. Givin you kisses up down and all around.
You're always at the top of my to-do list! Unfortunately truth is I do actually gotta go right now. Hang in there, V. Love ya lots!
Sat for a spell on the water tower yesterday, you know the one. Couldn't stop thinking about last time. Us up there, that view… Never thought I was the puppy love type, but here we are…
Ah good times… No, wait… the best times.

We replaced Evasion with a new mechanic called Mitigation. As a result, you'll find two new stats:
Mitigation Chance – your percent chance of activating Mitigation.
Mitigation Strength – the effectiveness of Mitigation. By default, Mitigation reduces damage received by 50%.
Both stats can be increased by leveling up your character and clothing mods, among others.

War without End: J. E. Davidson's Final Confession

(...) the AV drops even lower. So low I can see every inch of the transporters rumbling over the open Arizona plains. We land behind enemy lines, a cloud of dust our momentary cover. We  crawl our way over to the NUSA position; we're close enough to smell their sweat. At the signal... it's fucking showtime.

I take a few guys by their humvee. They reach for their guns – too slow. I unload my whole magazine into them, turning them into a smoking bloodstain. Good start. I reload. Just as I turn to run, I glimpse an Ajax barrel pointing right at me.

A fucking kid. It's a fucking kid holding the gun. Skin and bones with a mass of non-regulation curls shoved under his helmet. I don't like my chances, but hell, you only live once. I fire up my synaptic accelerator and lift my rifle. Not quick enough.

I'm hit three times - leg, lung, collarbone. The fourth bullet nearly rips my head off, throwing me back like a ragdoll. I tumble into darkness.

My own scream jerks me out of my chair. Instinctively, I reach for the titanium threads they fastened to my head. The bartender stares for a second, blinks, then goes back to wiping down the bar. I calm down. I'm where I'm supposed to be, in some smoke-filled dive on the outskirts of Night City. That fucking dream again. But Arizona's far, far away. No wonder I fell asleep right here.

I check the time. Fifteen minutes till the bus arrives. I down the rest of my foamy beer, grab my jacket and head out.

The neon signs blaze against the overcast night sky. Somewhere on a corner, a cab driver reams out a corpo who barfed all over his seats. Gangoons play night ball on a flickering court. I stop by the depot and wait. 

The bus arrives on time. Tourists pour out on the sidewalk. He's among them. Young guy, just as unassuming as before. He shifts his backpack, scratches under his curly head of hair, clutches a city guide.

I wet my lips and shift the knife in my pocket. As he walks off, I'm right behind him. Through the alleyways and streets, step by step, inching closer.

There are wars you never return from. That's what I tell myself. Or maybe I say it to him? I don't even know. Only thing I know is: it's gonna be a real good night. (...)

The Senkoh LX has made big splashes in corporate fashion circles. It looks like an expensive, brand-name accessory... and that's because it is. The Arasaka Corporation has partnered up with luxury clothier, Jinguji, to create this little wonder. The marriage of cutting-edge technology with chic corpowear has given birth to the perfect complementary piece for all of this season's top styles. But don't forget – the engineers at Arasaka never settle for inferior performance, so expect the same precision and power as you would from any firearm in their arsenal. The neanderthals on Night City's streets will tuck just about any old piece of iron under their belt, but the corporate game is played on an entirely different level of finesse.

Ready to change the landscape of smarty weaponry, Tsunami Defense Systems crashed onto the scene with a force worthy of a, well… you know. But to compete with top competitors Arasaka and Kang Tao, you need a cutting-edge product. This is why Tsunami has poured tremendous resources into the AI-powered processors they use in their Kappa handgun. Tsunami's latest software update has brought Kappa to the forefront of the smartgun debate. Add to that their strong reputation for quality craftsmanship, and you get a weapon that has raised eyebrows throughout the market – even if it hasn't dethroned the industry leaders just yet.

Midnight Arms' light machine gun is "light" in name only. The MA70 HB is a bona fide steel cannon for your personal arsenal. This American manufacturer built its reputation on supplying police departments and security agencies. While their designs aren't always the sleekest, they are undeniably solid and available at reasonable prices. Should you dare to shoulder their behemoth LMG, the MA70 HB, it's wise to first install cyberware to reinforce your upper body and spine. Wielding such a formidable weapon without the proper structural precautions will likely mean a trip to the ripperdoc for both you and your target. But if it's any consolation, your target will have to be taken there in a bucket.

Rostović may not be considered a top-tier arms manufacturer, but their Kolac rifle is nothing to sneeze at. If you're shopping for reliable accuracy and dependable durability, look no further. And with such an affordable price tag, the Kolac feels like a steal. Unfortunately, ergonomics were not a top priority during development. While undeniably precise, this rifle feels heavy and unbalanced. From a quality of life standpoint, this is where Rostović falls behind competitors such as Arasaka, Kang Tao, Tsunami and Militech. Still, if the Kolac has earned a spot with Serbia's armed forces, there's no reason to doubt its effectiveness on the streets of Night City.

The name of this semi-automatic rifle refers to the nine-tailed fox of myth. No, the Kyubi doesn't have nine barrels, but with the way it rains bullets on your enemies, you wouldn't know. Tsunami Defense Systems strives for quality craftsmanship and unparalleled optics in all of its weapons. The Kyubi is no exception. Its factory-issue laser sight offers for precise marksmanship right out of the box. And while some scoff at the plastic casing, Tsunami's engineers stand by the design. They aren't cutting corners to to save money – they're delivering one of the lightest, yet most reliable and powerful rifles on the market.

The engineers at Soviet arms giant Techtronika are driven by two core metrics: firepower and reliability. A simple design means fewer opportunities for breakage or jamming. And when you're fighting a heavily-modified adversary, you need those high-caliber rounds to strike true – without risk of failure. Although Techtronika has not altered the Pozhar's design for decades, their sales have scarcely dipped. In fact, it has long remained a favorite among MaxTac's elite forces, which should say more about its merits than any ad campaign or user review ever could. The only knocks against this weapon are its relatively poor ergonomic design and extremely powerful kick. No matter your experience level, consider investing in cyberware to absorb the recoil. Techtronika will not be held liable for a user's shattered bones.

Roach Race, based on true events

“Later, it was said the man came from the north, from Roper's Gate. He came on foot, leading his laden horse by the bridle...”

Stories abound on what happened next, but not many know the events preceding this moment.

Why lead the horse instead of riding it? That was no coincidence, for on that day, tensions between the man and his steed were running high. The horse tossed her head, chomped at the bit, laid back her ears... To say Roach was in a bad mood would be an understatement. And for good reason, too.

Earlier that day, she had uncovered a truth so disheartening it was too much to bear (though she'd borne many a burden in her lifetime.) As it turned out, she wasn’t the first and only Roach. And try as she might, the horse couldn’t stop worrying she wouldn't be the last...

Distraught and heartbroken, she leapt out and into the open world, devouring apples and carrots at full gallop. As was the case with all of his more complex relationships, the white-haired man understood his loss only when he saw the horse’s rump disappear into the distance. He couldn’t allow her – the only creature that understood him without words – to leave him forever.

He gave chase, starting an epic journey no bard has yet set forth in song...

Healthcare and Traffic Safety – Trauma Team Leads the Way

Second-rate equipment, under-trained medical “professionals”, and high death rates – this is the best Night City’s public emergency services have to offer. In addition to poor performance metrics, so too has their public image suffered. Scandals involving city EMTs colluding with scavengers have gone from rare to commonplace.

Recent cuts in municipal healthcare spending have led to the outright collapse of a medical system that already underperformed by most standards in the developed world. Ironically, this so-called “reform” resulted in a greater drain of doctors, nurses, paramedics and dispatchers from the public sector. Where quality healthcare was spotty before, now too is even calling the emergency hotline. Should you be among the lucky to reach a dispatcher, expect more than a half hour for an ambulance to arrive. And should you not bleed out before reaching the hospital, you’re even less likely to find an available bed. Recent data show a survival rate for traffic accidents in Night City at a meager 17%.

For comparison, the average survival rate for traffic accidents across all Trauma Team policies is 91%. Response time is guaranteed to never exceed 3 minutes. Heaven on Earth? No. The minimum we all deserve. Something to keep in mind as you plan your personal budget... Purchase Trauma Team’s Platinum-level coverage for the cost of Gold and safeguard your life today. Arasaka Academy emerged as the #1 ranked institute of secondary education in Night City for the fourth consecutive time according to the Night City Perspective’s annual review. The periodical earns the lion’s share of its advertising revenue from the academy’s namesake corporation, though their editorial staff claim this financial cooperation does not influence their rankings.

The magazine’s education experts claim Arasaka Academy’s infrastructure has no equal in Night City. Bias or otherwise, we cannot argue them on this point. Lessons are primarily conducted via virtual reality or AI-generated lesson plans suited to a student group’s specific needs. Public schools, meanwhile, can only dream... It comes as no surprise, then, that parents who are not gainfully employed at a megacorp are increasingly willing to incur a lifetime of debt for a chance to give their child a chance at the city’s most prestigious education.

But there are many uncomfortable truths the Academy is struggling to keep silent. Academy administrators promote a culture of constructive competition among its pupils as a way to forge the world’s next great corporate executives. A rat race by another name with a diploma at the finish line...

Night City Perspective factors placement in corporate leadership roles into their calculations, and with this criterion I take no issue. What they don’t include, however, is the drop-out rate. The enormous pressures these students face inevitably translate to anxiety, depression and, for some, even suicide. These rates are especially high for students outside the Arasaka corporate family. Such is the dark side of Arasaka Academy’s glowing reputation.

Thank you for reading and supporting independent journalism! Find more inconvenient truths, visit my blog. Your donations keep the lights on and my coffee mug full.

Navigating Night City can be a challenge. Narrow streets, dense traffic… But don’t sweat it. Here are some tips that will help you get around with any vehicle.

Maintaining Traction

Your tires can only handle so much at once. If you need to turn hard, avoid braking and accelerating hard at the same time. Brake before the corner, then steer smoothly into it. Stay off the brakes and gas mid turn, then accelerate gently as you come out of the corner. This will improve your speed and stability. When your tires start to smoke and squeal, it means you’re either approaching or exceeding the maximum grip they can provide.

Oversteer and Understeer

Ever entered a corner at high speed but it feels like your vehicle won’t turn? That's called understeer. To avoid it, slow down before entering the corner and try not to accelerate or brake mid corner.

Or maybe you’ve tried to turn hard at high speed but the rear of the vehicle whipped around, causing you to spin out of control? This is oversteer. Braking before the turn and careful acceleration mid corner can help prevent it, but you can also steer into the direction of the slide to correct it and regain stability. This is called countersteering.

During an oversteer slide, you can also keep your foot on the gas and apply the right amount of countersteer to enter and maintain a controlled slide. Congrats – now you’re drifting!

Effective Braking

You can brake in two ways: Brakes and the Handbrake. Regular brakes apply to all wheels and are the most effective way to bring you to a stop. If you apply them while stopped, they will put your vehicle in reverse. While in reverse, your input for Brake now accelerates and your input for Accelerate now brakes.

The Handbrake only applies to the rear wheels, so it is not as effective, but you can use it to execute sharp turns and reverse direction quickly if you use it without accelerating. If you want to slide (i.e. drift) through a turn, tap the Handbrake just before turning while continuing to accelerate. With the right countersteering and enough practice, you’ll be able to control your slide through the entire corner.

Keyboard (Digital) vs Controller (Analog)

Some driving techniques require gentle or gradual input for acceleration and braking. Unfortunately, keyboards don’t accommodate gradual input. Controllers are better suited for driving because analog triggers and sticks work best for slow, smooth inputs. Try pressing your Accelerate and Brake inputs gently at first, then gradually apply more pressure to experiment with how acceleration, braking and steering interact. Often just a little is just right.

Maximizing Camera Perspective

Each camera perspective has its own merits. First-Person Perspective (FPP) may improve your sense of immersion, giving you the impression you’re really behind the wheel. Third-Person Perspective (TPP), by contrast, improves visibility and awareness of your surroundings. But no matter which perspective you use, you can still manually rotate the camera and reset it with a single button press.

TPP has three camera distances you can select in game and two camera heights you can select from in the Settings. The camera system is intentionally designed to require more player input to get the best view of the action. It’s worth practicing and experimenting with camera control so you can learn to position it to see where you’re going before you get there.

In Night City, every ride has its own charm, character and performance. Pick the one that suits your style, packs enough punch to be fun, and has handling characteristics that feel natural to you!

That said, vehicles that share the same engine placement and drive-wheel configuration will also share similar handling traits. There are three drive-wheel configurations: front, rear and all-wheel. Each has unique traction behavior under different circumstances. There are also three engine placements: front, mid and rear. This affects a vehicle's center of mass and thus its handling. Don’t know what a given ride has? Scan it! But if there’s any doubt, you can always pop the trunk or hood to see for yourself.

Front-Wheel Drive, Front Engine

These vehicles are typically the easiest to drive with good traction on slippery surfaces, and predictable understeer when pushed too hard. Engaging Burn Out mode mid-turn will produce a milder slide than with other configurations.

Rear-Wheel Drive, Front Engine

A classic combination for luxury, sport and muscle cars, designed for drivers with above-average skill. This configuration provides near-even weight balance with the engine at the front and passengers and drive axle towards the rear. Handling is generally neutral, producing only mild oversteer, but heavy gas mid corner can kick the rear out, allowing for drifting and quick changes of direction.

All-Wheel Drive, Front Engine

An excellent choice for medium-skill drivers who like to move fast whether in the city or off road. Considered the most stable configuration, you can brake or accelerate in the middle of a turn much more than in others, allowing for both beautiful slides as well as incredible traction and speed when exiting corners.

Rear-Wheel Drive, Mid or Rear Engine

A configuration for only the most skilled gearheads. With most of the weight behind the driver, these vehicles can understeer under acceleration when turning, and can spin if you Accelerate or Brake too suddenly mid corner. To keep these vehicles in one piece, it requires slow and smooth inputs. But if you’ve got the skill, they can provide a unique and rewarding thrill ride… if you like livin’ on the edge.

All-Wheel Drive, Mid or Rear Engine

This combination gives the feel of a RWD mid engine, but with the traction of AWD, and is favored by powerful, high-end exotics. Driven gingerly, they benefit from stable handling with mild understeer, but they can put down power like no other configuration and change direction easily. If you notice too much understeer, just feed it more gas. Put the pedal to the metal coming out of a corner, and they’ll have you flyin’ down the road like a bat outta hell!

A “burn out” occurs when the drive wheels spin faster than the vehicle is moving, causing the tires to melt and smoke, but Burn Out Mode can do so much more. Try engaging it at medium and lower speeds and applying different levels of input. To get the most out of Burn Out Mode, we recommend driving with a controller rather than a keyboard. Analog triggers and sticks allow you to gradually or partially apply the brake and gas, which is crucial for some of these maneuvers.

To engage Burn Out Mode, press and hold Brake and Accelerate simultaneously either while stopped or moving at lower speeds. Your drive wheels will start to burn out, while the opposite wheels brake, keeping the vehicle mostly in place (technically, this is a Brake Stand).

Turning Around in Tight Spaces

Car stuck in a narrow, dead-end alleyway? Engage Burn Out Mode and begin steering to rotate your vehicle on the spot!

Tire Temperature and High-Grip Boost

Spinning your tires builds heat, and heat improves their traction. Once you’ve got your tires good ‘n’ hot, release the brake to launch your vehicle with a drag-race-like High-Grip Boost. Note: Tire temperature only affects the grip of the tires during launch.

Stunting, Drifting, Donuts, Rolling Brake Stands and More!

With Burn Out Mode engaged from a stop, slowly release the brake to perform a rolling brake stand. You can steer at the same time to rotate the vehicle and smoke the tires.

To drift, you can either apply the Handbrake during a turn or by engaging Burn Out Mode when entering a corner at lower speeds. Practice enough and you can pull off donuts, learn to drift in a circle or just quickly change direction. You could even trigger a High-Grip Boost then and take off like a shot. This mode isn’t just for fun – it can also bail you out when things get hot and you need a slick getaway!

Front-Wheel Drive Vehicles

Burn Out Mode can be engaged with this vehicle type, but the ability to perform some maneuvers is limited compared to vehicles with other drivetrain configurations.

All-Wheel Drive Vehicles

These vehicles use on-board computers that determine how much power goes to the front or rear wheels. When Burn Out Mode is engaged, the computers kill power to the front wheels, causing the vehicle to behave as if it’s rear-wheel drive. The same effect happens when a Handbrake is used.

Heavy-Duty Vehicles

Burn Out Mode can technically be activated for any vehicle, but some of the largest, slowest vehicles can never get their wheels spinning fast enough to have any real effect.

Keyboard Limitations – WASD and Arrow Key Bindings

If you are using a keyboard to drive (again, a controller is recommended), please note that many keyboards do not register more than 2 keys pressed at the same time if located near each other. For example, if you engage Burn Out Mode by holding the W and S keys, the A and D keys may not work. This is why we have the arrow keys simultaneously bound for driving controls. You can work around the aforementioned problem by activating Burn Out Mode with the W and S keys and using the left and right arrow keys to steer.

So, think you’ve got the basics down? Then it’s time for a few pro tips. 

Pay Attention to Your Tires

If you push your tires to the limit, they’ll start to squeal and smoke. Take this as a warning sign you’re about to lose traction. If you notice the front wheels squealing first or more than in the rear, this means the vehicle will experience understeer if you continue to push it. If the rear tires are squealing more, then expect oversteer instead. Recognizing these signs early may mean you’ll have time to counter the effect. If your main objective is pure speed, try not to smoke your tires as that creates too much friction, which slows you down, and adds resistance to your engine.

Listen for Chassis Impacts

Night City has many drivable surfaces, everything from smooth roads to bumpy roads to fully off road. Some vehicles are more suited for a given road surface because of their suspension type and ground clearance. If you’re going over bumpy desert terrain in a low-clearance exotic car, for example, you may hear crash-like sounds, notice the vehicle bouncing and find it difficult to control. This is because the bottom of the car is hitting the ground.

The Handbrake: Emergency Braking vs Drifting

The Handbrake is a versatile tool depending on what you use it for. Of course, pressing it while not accelerating will lock the rear tires and bring you to a halt. You can also turn at the last moment for a sharp turn or spin. But if you continue to accelerate while using the Handbrake, it acts more like a drift button, halving the brake power and creating a smoother slide. You can continue to hold it for as long as you like, but typically a quick tap to initiate a slide is enough for a simple drift.

Free Rev with Grip Boost – Forward and Reverse

From Burn Out Mode you can only launch forward. However, you can still perform a High-Grip Boost from a standstill in both forward AND reverse if you launch while using Free Rev and your tires haven’t cooled yet. To Free Rev, hold Accelerate or Brake while holding Handbrake to make your engine rev up, then release just the Handbrake to launch. If you’re holding Brake, you’ll perform a High-Grip Boost in reverse!

J-Turns (AKA Rockfords)

A J-Turn is a driving maneuver that allows you to drive in reverse, then quickly rotate the vehicle 180 degrees and continue driving in the same direction but now facing forward. It can also be performed from forward to reverse. To go from reverse to forward, go as fast as possible in reverse with Brake, turn sharply to face the direction in which you are already moving, then press Accelerate. Going from forward to reverse works in a similar way, although you will need to use the Handbrake to perform the sharp 180-degree turn. The vehicle’s computer will know if you are attempting a J-Turn and will do a super quick flat-shift from reverse to first gear (or vice versa) once the turn is complete.

Maximizing Burn Out Mode

We encourage you to experiment with Burn Out Mode at different speeds and to combine different maneuvers. One example: Use the Handbrake to start an aggressive slide, then engage Burn Out Mode by simultaneously pressing Accelerate and Brake at lower speeds, slide to face any direction, and release the Brake to launch with a High-Grip Boost.

Another example: Say you’re moving in reverse then decide to go forward. Ordinarily, you would stop pressing Brake and start pressing Accelerate, which would slow the car to a complete stop and then smoothly shift from reverse to first gear. Instead, you can engage Burn Out Mode, which immediately flat shifts the vehicle into first gear, smokes the tires and provides immediate forward thrust.

Remember – Burn Out Mode also works on bikes, but with a couple preem differences. A High-Grip Boost on a bike can trigger wheelies, and the much increased grip you get off the line can be used to do things and get places that aren’t possible in other vehicles!

When he was still Wade Bleecker the Petrochem employee, practically everyone knew him. Since scrubbing his identity from existence and adopting the persona of Mr. Hands, Pacifica's resident fixer, that's no longer the case. His appearance and true identity are a closely guarded secret.

In his previous life, Wade climbed fairly high up the Petrochem corporate ladder. Unfortunately for Bleecker, he was chosen as its unfortunate sacrificial lamb. He proved cunning enough to survive the initial assassination attempt, but when an official bounty was put on his head, he had no choice but to change his name and face and disappear for good.

Mr. Hands is a businessman through and through – cool-headed, calculating and supremely focused on his objective. Precisely what that objective is, however, remains a mystery to all but Mr. Hands himself.

Before he became a well-known fixer in Santo Domingo, El Capitan was Muamar Reyes – a corpo rat at a company that dealt in... ah who the hell cares anyway. But, all too quickly he realized that with corps it's always the same ol' tune – either they fuck you, or you fuck them. He preferred the latter.\n\nOften those who escape poverty like to help out their less fortunate peers – like El Capitan. Well, kinda. He makes a fortune as the go-to fixer for half of Santo Domingo's working class, but hey – at least he makes sure they can still afford their rent too. Don't like his style? Find your own gigs. But when a gangoon decides they'd rather save a buck by breaking your legs instead of paying your cut, look around – might just see El Capitan watching from his limo window with a smirk on his face.

The perfect companion if you crave a refreshing beverage and surprisingly good company. Despite his appearance as no more than a simple Spontaneous Satisfaction Craving Machine (S.C.S.M), his affable personality and highly-advanced empathy algorithm can successfully compete with real, human relationships. In the dehumanized reality of the city, where ruthlessness and strength earn prestige, Brendan remains the best bud anyone could ask for.

For some, the greatest stage artist of 2077; for others, a living, breathing ad for the full cybernetic body conversion offered by MoorE Technologies. Opinions aside, there is no denying that almost everyone around the world has heard of Elizabeth Wissenfurth, more widely known as Lizzy Wizzy.

Perhaps most famous for enacting her own death on stage followed by life-saving surgery, her critics claim Lizzy Wizzy is nothing more than a capitalist commodity assuming the guise of art. Lizzy herself seems to be deliberately toying with her audience, purporting to be the embodiment of future, or as she would say, "a chrome mirror in which social hyperconsciousness is reflected".

There are also those who fear the great artist replacing her entire body with chrome is slowly losing touch with reality and her own humanity. But isn't that what artists are for? To question the limits of humanity? And, if necessary, to sacrifice themselves for an answer?

If you were afraid of monsters under your bed as a kid, rest assured - this converted Thorton Mackinaw monster truck would never fit. Not even in a standard-sized studio unit. This Mackinaw's gigantic engine compartment is packed with industrial turbines and a thick tangle of intake system parts and exhaust manifolds. The raised body is crowned by an open-air cabin with a massive rollbar and chimneys that would belong better in a coal-fired power plant - only less environmentally-friendly. Interestingly, this "Demiurge" variant retained the interior and engine of the original Mackinaw, but with its electronic muzzle removed it can reach more than 1,000 horsepower. Add to that two torsion axles and a double-damper suspension and you can start terrorizing the streets in no time.

entries.femaleVariant:
Something happened. I don't know how to put it into words. I saw… a vision? A hallucination? One moment, walking in circles, barefoot in the sand. The next, suddenly indoors... a room, wholly unfamiliar.

But there was someone else. Sitting and watching a TV (or monitor?)

I couldn't see their face, but I could make out the image on their screen. It was me. They were watching me. Or rather... watching THROUGH me? It doesn't make any sense.

Whoever this "watcher" is, they were supremely focused as they watched. No... not watched, so much as observed... seemingly unaware I was in the room with them.

As I write this, I'm back in the desert. I don't remember how or when I awoke. I don't know how long this "dream" lasted (for lack of a better word).

I'm going back. I have to. But I need to prepare.

It was clearer this time. The watcher sat exactly where they had before, but this time I could make out some sounds.

I could discern more detail but it required immense focus, effort... this punishing pressure?. As if someone (or something?) didn't want me to see, as if I was a persona non grata in this place - but present all the same.

I studied the watcher in an attempt to learn more their intent, their purpose. The monitor appeared to be connected to a computer terminal.

This time was different than before - I didn't see myself on that screen. The image showed Night City, seen from the above, like drone footage.

The watcher is spying not only on me, but all of us... why? why why why...

It's time to make contact; to let the watcher know that they, too, are being watched.

It was clearer this time. The watcher sat exactly where they had before, but this time I could make out some sounds.

I could discern more detail but it required immense focus, effort... this punishing pressure?. As if someone (or something?) didn't want me to see, as if I was a persona non grata in this place - but present all the same.

I studied the watcher in an attempt to learn more their intent, their purpose. The monitor appeared to be connected to a kind of compact computer... an entertainment console? I've seen nothing like it, yet somehow I feel certain.

This time was different than before - I didn't see myself on that screen. The image showed Night City, seen from the above, like drone footage.

The watcher is spying not only on me, but all of us... why? why why why...

It's time to make contact; to let the watcher know that they, too, are being watched.

An empty room. the watcher was gone.
I wanted to leave, to see more, but the farther i got from the screen, the more I was drawn back to it.

I sat, taking the watcher's place, focused on the image, blurry, indistinct, but gradually sharpened... that familiar outline

the watcher! sitting in their usual spot but now on my screen... looking at them, through them...
annd they watched me
watching them
watching me
watching them

then a presence in the room. I turnde around - no one

When I turned back , THEIR EYES - no longer staring at an image of me on the screen but at ME, THE REAL ME

I'm afraid
but i must return

I understand now.
but it's too late…

Something ends.
Will end?
Has ended.

Farewell

I wandered a dark forest. The paths before me deliberately tangled. My steps were misled, the moon rose in a different place every night. I had to lose all hope to find the treasure at the very bottom. They tried to hide it from us, but the truth refused to stay hidden.

Now that I carry the key, I feel at peace. I will not run. There's no point. Their eyes see everything. Those dead, glassy eyes. And the dead stars reflected in them.

The key is the prize. Not all deserve to hold it. I will be its guardian for what little time I have left.

Polyhistor will soon see the truth. What will he do with it? Accept it? Or choose life and the lie that it is?

Just reviewed the spectroscopic data you sent. Some anomalies, yeah, but nothin to tickle your testes over. Not yet anyway. Might just be poorly calibrated equipment (Kabuki techwizards strike again).

In any case, gonna rerun the analysis on a different set of parameters. The bacteriophage theory is a pretty damn sexy one, gotta say, but don't wanna warp the facts just to fit what we think we're lookin for.

I'll send ya a crosstab with the results. Take a look when ya get the chance. Maybe you can squeeze more juice outta this than I can.

Wondering what our monk chooms are up to? Zilch. That is to say, the same shit as usual. Pace back and forth back and forth under that statue, meditate, mumble something, meditate some more, in general go about their monk business. We ain't gonna learn jack this way. I'm about to start pushin em for answers, literally if need be. You know... who are you? Who am I? Why are we all here? What the fuck is all this about?\n\nBut I will say, I've found a silver lining in this massive waste of time. Unlike those monks, we're free to get as shitfaced as we please. So whaddaya say? Wanna hit the city? I need to let off some steam and it'd do you good to get outta that dusty-ass shack. We're in this together, aren't we? Maybe a beer or five is all we need for a breakthrough, to start askin ourselves the right questions. For instance: what the FUCK is the difference between magenta and fuchsia anyway?

I almost laugh when I think of all the time wasted on those sad, conjured-up theories of mine. I felt genuine relief when I purged my previous notes; the gibberish of a self-proclaimed genius turned fool. Embarrassing.

It was TyRo//\antA who lifted the veil of secrecy; the first of us with such a breakthrough! I couldn't believe it until I saw it myself - a long-forgotten, archaic game, and within it... not an answer, but a clue. The keyhole we must find is in a door that we took for a wall.

For the time being, I've cut off all network connections to the mainframe and programmed it to accept eight datapoints.

It's time to break the news to my brothers and sisters in Night City. Face to face; I owe them that.

Besides, TyRo//\aNtA was right - our email correspondence put us all at too much risk.

I have it, Polyhistor. I'm not wrong this time. I just need more time to understand.

First things first... You probably think I've finally lost my mind. Maybe. In truth, I began to doubt whether the answer we were looking could ever be found. What if we sought meaning where none existed? But I know now that we were RIGHT. To find the correct path forward, I had to first leave the wrong one I was already following. That's when I found IT.

I'll be honest, I slipped into a dark pit of apathy and despair. I left the net to seek solace in a world of fleeting, physical pleasures. I needed to feel something... anything. As I wandered Night City, I found an old arcade. Vintage games. I had forgotten such places existed, even though, in a previous life, they used to be my home away from home. That's where saw it - A SIGN. FF06B5 -- a pixel hidden in code, over 50 years old.

Do you understand what this means? The path we must follow goes much farther and much, much deeper than we could've imagined. From this point on, none of us are safe. They know the secret is out.

This will be my last message. I'm leaving, taking nothing with me but my laptop. You have to discover for yourself what I have. I told you once about a game that changed my life. Think back and remember it. Because that same game has changed my life a second time.

And now it will change yours.

Growl FM is a Dogtown-based underground radio station aimed catering to anti-establishment listeners. NC authorities have classified the station as pirate radio, regularly confiscating or destroying its illegally-installed transmitters. Yet Growl FM always finds a way back to its listeners' ears. The charismatic and uncompromising voice of Growl FM, DJ Ash, speaks to her audience directly and spews nothing but the truth - a claim denied by the station's critics. Once she's researched a story, she doesn't pull any punches, often covering risky stories about corporations, officials, politicians, gangoons, warlords and ordinary citizens. The news and reports on Growl FM spare no one, because in the world of Growl FM, nobody is untouchable. And let's not forget the music - carefully curated, bold, sometimes surprising - another reason why Growl FM has so many loyal listeners.

At first glance, quiet, timid and cautious; at second glance, prudent and professional. She works a high-paying corpo job in an unspecified company - work she excels at. After hours she engages in unofficial netrunning for purposes known only to herself, a pastime she almost paid for with her life.

Chang-Hoon sees himself as a bundle of contradictions constantly battling for dominance in his mind. Ambition versus aloofness; the desire to help others versus his own safety; hunger for knowledge at odds with wanting a bit of peace and quiet. For a netrunner, it's a highly unusual set of traits. Chang-Hoon is an experienced analyst and explorer of cyberspace. His code and daemons are often similar in their MO as him: effective, but tame. Perhaps that's why he frequently collaborates with Wakako Okada. The Watson fixer likes to rely on him because he's dependable, and in turn he likes to know what's expected of him. Which is not to say that Chang-Hoon doesn't enjoy a bit of risk - what netrunner doesn't? But some risks are too tempting to refuse even when common sense tells him otherwise. He has the same thought every time: "Every time you take a risk, you get into Trouble. Capital 'T' kind of trouble." That's why Chang-Hoon thinks long and hard before each assignment, assessing whether it might be his last. Until now, he's been lucky.

Anyone who amounts to anything should know Nix. He's the go-to netrunner in town for tasks others refuse to take even for fat stacks. Shady and dangerous work is right up his street, though Nix isn't some crazy cyberspace cowboy - he's just an experienced professional who's done his homework on analyzing and deciphering the shreds of knowledge left behind by legendary 'runner Rache Bartmoss. He also had a corpo stint, which he certainly doesn't share often, but which he counts among the most teachable periods in his life. No matter which suit he wore, it always felt too tight - literally and metaphorically. He's now one of Rogue's most trusted netrunners and is keen to keep it that way.

Whenever Carol received corporate job offers, she was told it would allow her to settle down in the city, save some eddies and find her place on Earth. The problem was that Carol had found this place long ago among the Aldecaldos nomads. Sure, it might have been more comfortable to work in a swanky office equipped with top-of-the-line equipment... but with the Aldecaldos she found something more valuable: a sense of belonging, a feeling of being needed, that those she holds dear can rely on her skills. That feeling of being part of something... something which she grew to call family. This was her place on Earth and she wouldn't give it up for anything.\nShe never mentions her real family. Barely out of her teens, she fled her small town in Maryland and enlisted in the army. She was trained as a netrunner and technician, capable of operating heavy panzers. But when her contract ended, she became convinced the army was just another corporation - albeit one that didn't bother to hide the bloodshed on the front lines. So she left and joined the nomads. Life on the road helped her gain the right perspective and skills, but it wasn't until the Aldecaldos that she found a home and family - not by blood, but by choice - worth protecting. No matter the cost.

Yoko doesn't have many friends - her therapist once said it was because she has trust and attachment issues. Yoko confirmed that diagnosis by quitting therapy. It wasn't about emotions. It was about Night City and her place in it. Yoko likes her space - in this case, her store and workshop in Kabuki where she sells netrunning gear and sometimes black market items not easily found elsewhere. Yoko doesn't trust people because it's the reasonable mindset to have. That doesn't mean she doesn't care about them - her customers, for example. Maybe with a little luck and different life choices, she would be a highly-paid corpo netrunner. But she chose Kabuki. Regrets? Nah. Here, at least, she feels she has control in her little sanctuary - peddling netrunner tech, the occasional rare piece of chrome, experimental daemons and digital artifacts from forgotten corners of cyberspace. It just makes her... happy. Those who've used her services keep coming back. And the problems they come in with, the goods they seek and the stories they tell give Yoko what no corporate job would give her - the feeling of being needed.

Perfect for when you want to "cut yourself off" from any problems you come across.
